Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$121,134.00 - $181,700.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

Title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining, reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst position is $120,000 annually [or $57.70 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst position is $130,000 annually [or $62.50 per hour]. The compensation yield to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity: CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

Title: Senior People Analytics Data Analyst
Description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Responsibilities


Analyze HR data to deeply understand processes, trends, and opportunities, ensuring findings are actionable and aligned with organizational goals.
Design and implement advanced data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or PowerBI to drive strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with HR and business teams to identify to develop metrics that promote excellence and optimize workflows.
Perform detailed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of insights provided to stakeholders.
Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively, ensuring all stakeholders understand implications and actions.
Develop and maintain data documentation, run books, and data dictionaries in collaboration with HR data governance.
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in people analytics and apply them to enhance our workforce strategies.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related domains.

Description:
Job Description

Nordstrom is committed to being the leader in Omnichannel retailing. We have long recognized the importance of having strong capabilities in both Physical and Digital retailing and we continue to innovate on how we can help our customers Feel Good and Look Their Best.

The Data Analyst 3 is an individual contributor on the Merchandising Insights & Strategic Operations (MISO) team within Inventory. MISO sits at the center of how inventory moves through Nordstrom, supporting Merch Ops, Inbound Flow, RP, and Supplier Compliance. You'll build the analytics that help those teams see what's happening, spot problems early, and make faster, better calls on how product flows from suppliers to our stores and customers.

The work is a mix of keeping the core reporting reliable and modernizing it. Our teams are moving dashboards and data sources onto Looker and BigQuery, and replacing legacy tools and servers with newer platforms, so you'll help make sure the numbers people rely on carry over accurately and get easier to use. You'll also help bring practical AI into the day-to-day, whether that's speeding up analysis, automating repetitive workflows, or showing partners what's possible with tools like Claude.

A day in the life…


Build, maintain, and evolve Looker dashboards and self-service tools that Merch Ops, Inbound Flow, RP, and Supplier Compliance rely on to run the business
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their analytics needs, and turn open-ended questions into clear, reliable answers
Own the data models and BigQuery queries behind inventory reporting, with a focus on accuracy, scalability, and reuse
Build and maintain Python and Airflow pipelines that keep key data fresh, validated, and monitored
Support the move from legacy reporting and data sources to Looker, BigQuery, and newer platform tools, making sure numbers carry over accurately
Use AI-assisted tools like Claude Code and Claude Desktop to speed up analysis, automate repetitive workflows, and raise the quality of your output
Dig into ad hoc analysis to explain inventory, inbound, replenishment, and supplier trends, and present findings to business partners and leadership
Work with Data Engineering, Insights, and Technology teams on data dependencies and platform changes
Share what you learn with the team, help set standards for how we build and document analytics, and help others get more out of the tools


You own this if you have…


Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, or related field required
4+ years of data analytics experience; demonstrated ability to deliver business-critical analytics independently and raise analytical standards across a team
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Desktop) to accelerate analysis, automate data workflows, and produce higher-quality output faster
Advanced SQL skills with hands-on BigQuery experience; strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and query construction
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain data pipelines and lightweight automation in Python, including validation, monitoring, and workflow scripts, with hands-on Airflow experience for scheduling and orchestration
Proficiency with at least one leading visualization tool (Looker preferred) and best practices for operational dashboarding
Strong operational business understanding, including the downstream effects of inventory flow, supplier performance, and replenishment decisions on cost and service
Supply chain expertise in retail or consumer goods preferred, with familiarity in inbound operations, inventory, replenishment, or supplier compliance
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting findings to business stakeholders and operational leadership

Description:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.


Compensation

Are you looking for a work environment which encourages teamwork and where you are respected, supported, challenged, and can grow and advance your career? If your answer is “yes,” you should join T-Mobile’s All-Star Legal Team!

T-Mobile has an exciting opportunity for a Principal Analyst with exceptional analytical and communication skills and a talent for creative problem-solving to provide business intelligence to our dynamic business teams. A successful candidate will be ready to jump into action, working closely with experts across the legal department and business partners to provide practical, strategic guidance and design and implement creative solutions to address complex legal and technological challenges.

This role delivers advanced quantitative and qualitative data to support decision-making. It involves creating internal client-centric solutions driven by data analysis, business acumen, creativity, and effective communication. The role leads the design and development of reporting structures and interfaces, administering standardized reports for cross-functional use. What You’ll Do In Your Role.


Transform complex business questions into actionable insights by integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems and sources.
Design and deliver executive-level dashboards, reporting solutions, AI-driven analytics and conversational AI tools that provide a comprehensive view of business performance and strategic initiatives.
Identify trends, opportunities, and risks within large datasets, translating findings into recommendations that enhance operational efficiency, drive decisions, and financial performance.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders early in the project lifecycle to define reporting, analytics, AI chat, and data requirements, ensuring measurement and visibility are embedded in solution design.
Deliver key performance indicators across Legal teams to drive data-informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with business and technology teams to improve data quality, AI and reporting capabilities, and analytics processes that enable scalable decision support.
Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders by leveraging data to influence business strategy, prioritize initiatives, and measure outcomes.
Lead or contribute to special projects and strategic initiatives that support evolving business objectives and organizational priorities.
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI solutions.

Bachelor's Degree plus 7 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 5 years of related experience.
Acceptable areas of study include Business, Statistics or similar degree.
7-10 years’ experience with business intelligence tools.

7-10 years’ experience in advanced analytics including SQL/ETL of complex datasets, quantitative analysis & research.

Title: Sr. Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. The team drives consumer adoption and expansion by analyzing market trends, optimizing acquisition strategies, and informing pricing and retention initiatives. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer growth.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
5+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
3+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
1+ years of experience leading projects


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The People Analytics Team

Our People Analytics team distills insights from our data to drive informed workforce decisions across the organization. We partner with stakeholders throughout the business to transform complex people data into actionable intelligence that optimizes the employee lifecycle and supports better business outcomes.

The Staff Data Analyst People Analytics Opportunity

This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead the design and delivery of people analytics solutions that directly impact workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience. You'll develop advanced predictive models, create scalable dashboards, and apply emerging AI technologies to solve complex workforce challenges while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

Analyze and report on the entire employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding through development and exit—by designing dashboards and reports that provide insights into hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, promotions, compensation, headcount, and organizational health
Partner with People Team leaders, stakeholders across the business, and data teams to translate business questions into analytical approaches, ensure data quality and governance, and deliver executive-ready insights
Design, build, and maintain predictive analytics models that identify workforce trends, risks, and opportunities, including attrition prediction, workforce forecasting, employee lifecycle analysis, and talent pipeline analytics
Apply advanced statistical techniques—including regression analysis, clustering, forecasting, survival analysis, and segmentation—to solve complex workforce challenges and inform strategic decision-making
Analyze employee feedback from surveys, onboarding, exit interviews, and other listening channels using Natural Language Processing and text analytics to identify emerging themes and actionable insights
Explore and prototype Generative AI use cases that automate narrative reporting, summarize workforce trends, and enhance decision support while maintaining governance and data privacy standards

What you'll bring to the role

7+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Science, or a related analytics discipline
Advanced proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools, data warehousing platforms, spreadsheet and SQL querying, and enterprise HR platforms
Having experience with our direct tech stack is highly preferred:
Data visualization and reporting: Tableau
Data warehousing: Snowflake
Spreadsheet and querying: Excel, SQL
Enterprise HR platforms: Workday, ServiceNow, Greenhouse
Demonstrated expertise applying advanced statistical methods including regression, clustering, forecasting, and text analytics
Excellent data visualization and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, influence decisions through data, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and automation
Familiarity with Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and other emerging AI technologies applied to analytics
Experience implementing sound data management and governance practices across large, complex datasets

This role partners closely with leaders and stakeholders across the organization to identify reporting needs, analyze trends, improve data quality, and develop scalable analytics solutions.

As a senior analyst, this position leads complex analytical initiatives, establishes reporting standards and best practices, mentors less experienced analysts, and drives data-informed decisions that support organizational goals. The Information Analyst III serves as a trusted advisor for workforce analytics and business intelligence needs across multiple functional areas.

This is a hybrid role, located on our campus in Mountlake Terrace WA

What You'll Do


Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, define reporting requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational performance, reduce costs, support compliance, and enhance workforce effectiveness.
Design, develop, document, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, data models, and analytical solutions that support workforce management and organizational decision-making.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights.
Develop automated reporting and dashboard solutions that improve visibility into key workforce, operational, and business performance metrics.
Validate and peer review analytical work, reports, and dashboards to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established standards.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting processes, operational databases, and overall analytical efficiency; recommend and implement solutions.
Lead complex analytical projects and cross-functional initiatives, coordinating efforts to achieve project goals and measurable business outcomes.
Analyze and resolve complex reporting and data issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
Create and maintain technical documentation, reporting standards, data definitions, and process documentation.
Provide mentorship, guidance, and training to analysts and business partners on reporting tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Assist with project planning by estimating resource requirements, effort, timelines, and project complexity.
Develop workforce analytics, forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and operational performance reporting to support workforce management strategies.


What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; or four (4) years of equivalent work experience.
Five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business decision-making.


Preferred Qualifications


Three (3) or more years of experience in healthcare, health insurance, workforce management, or a related industry.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern analytics environments.
Experience developing workforce analytics, staffing models, forecasting solutions, scheduling analytics, or operational performance reporting.
Knowledge of contact center operations, workforce planning, or healthcare operational analytics.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Advanced knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, and data analytics methodologies.
Strong understanding of relational databases, data structures, data governance, and reporting best practices.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to mentor analysts and promote best practices in reporting, analytics, and data management.
Knowledge of healthcare operations, healthcare data, health insurance concepts, and workforce management principles.
Ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical and reporting solutions that drive measurable results.

At Premera, data plays a critical role in improving the health and well-being of our members and communities. Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Program Data Analyst
Description:
Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies.

Requirements

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform program/data analysis tasks, including:


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation


In addition, the Program/Data Analyst will:


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.)
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies
Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings
Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design-build and design-bid-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements
Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections
Provide technical support for construction field activities
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report
Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected
Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences
Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management
Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations


Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Benefits

Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and long-term success of our employees, including:

Competitive compensation

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Retirement plan with company contribution

Paid time off and federal holidays

Professional development and training opportunities

Supportive, family-focused company culture

Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

Title: SCS Business & Customer Insights Analyst II
Description:
Overview

The SCS (Sales & Customer Support) CX Insights Analyst II contributes to REI’s success by providing critical data insights, trends and analysis to enable data driven decision making, improve customer experiences across all SCS touchpoints, and support the evolution of the SCS team as we leverage technology to provide a seamless blend of expert human guidance and technology enabled solutions. The role acts a relentless advocate for our customers across their journey, identifying friction trends, quality and process improvements and utilizes voice of customer feedback/sentiment to drive action and prioritization of enterprise customer initiatives. The Analyst’s primary focus will be to complete recurring analysis, identify root causes of customer issues/pain points, and deliver concise, impactful summary of findings. Models and acts in accordance with the Co-op Way (values & mission).

Responsibilities And Qualifications

Responsibilities:


Analyze, report, and track information to identify data patterns and customer pain points using multiple data sources, including structured and unstructured customer research, benchmarks, demographics, and internal operational data.
Support SCS team share-outs with distilled insights from SCS CX Programs and listening channels to drive actionable, data-driven recommendations.
Engage in dialogue with stakeholders to understand the scope and impact of potential causes or changes to the customer experience, aiding in the interpretation of insights.
Participate in processes that drive ongoing evaluation and improvement in our listening programs, tools and dashboards (Customer intent/topic data, VOC, Quality Management).
Contribute to developing program solutions, including technical implementation of new technology platforms, systems, tools, vendor onboarding and management, integration, and ongoing data integrity maintenance of the SCS ecosystem. Requires understanding of tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Sigma, Digital Analytics - Adobe, Tealium).
Support managers with internal partner consultation, project coordination and execution, annual research, and budget planning.
Provide collaborative ad-hoc decision support and represent the voice and needs of customers among internal partners.
Monitor and evaluate accuracy and efficacy of listening tools, LLMS and sentiment analysis.
Perform regular deep dives and root cause analyses of top customer pain points.
Leverage metrics, feedback, and other data to understand the customer experience, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.



Qualifications:


A college degree (Bachelor’s or equivalent work experience) is required with data analytics, data science, business analytics, statistics, or marketing analytics and research focus.
5+ years of experience in similar business analytics, data science or insight roles preferably within retail/customer service.
Industry knowledge Quality, VOC, customer experience (CX), analytics, data, marketing, or other relevant experience/certifications.
High empathy to see the world through the customers eyes. Acts as an advocate for customer in the interest of building a customer-centric culture.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to explain and defend data analysis at all levels within the organization, including senior leadership. Proven ability to adapt communication style to audience (both written & verbal).
Experience completing in-depth analysis of structured & unstructured customer research data, identifying root cause of customer issues/pain points, and making recommendations on training opportunities, process improvements, and/or technology enhancements.
Technical experience in five or more of the following tools/areas of discipline: Reporting and Analytics, SQL, Sigma, Qualtrics, R/SAS, Data Consolidation, Data Visualization, Voice Analytics, Text Analytics, Report Automation, Customer Satisfaction (VOC) Metrics, Advanced Excel skills.
Ability to work independently and efficiently with a minimum of supervision. Ability to proactively manage expectations and work effectively in a collaborative, cross-divisional environment.
Proven experience using survey platforms (such as Qualtrics, business intelligence programs (such as Tableau), and statistical software (such as SPSS) to analyze data. Intermediate to advanced knowledge/use of business-related PC applications, such as Excel, Word, Outlook, and Power Point.
Actively participates and collaborates with others on one's own team and across REI for the achievement of business goals.
Challenges the status quo, champions change and influences others to change.
Executes effectively by using resources efficiently, meeting deadlines, and keeping others informed of work plans and progress toward goals.
Works smart by setting effective work goals, establishing priorities, using resources efficiently, meeting deadlines, and proactively keeping others informed of work plans and progress.



Closing

At REI, we believe the outdoors is for all. We are committed to becoming a fully inclusive, anti-racist, multicultural organization. We know that there's strength in our diversity – that each employee brings unique skills, experiences, and perspectives. Every day you are driving change, fostering a culture of respect, and knowing you're backed by benefits that support your whole life. To work towards this commitment and fulfill our brand promise of inspiring and enabling a life outside for everyone, we seek employees who demonstrate different ways of working, create a sense of belonging, and actively listen and learn.  

Pay Transparency 

We are committed to practices that promote pay equity and transparency. As required by applicable Pay Transparency laws, REI provides a range of compensation for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location or other relevant factors.   

REI offers all regular employees a generous employee discount, access to health benefits, a retirement savings plan and accrued time off.  Click here for a detailed overview of benefits plans by employee profile.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave

Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days

Employee resource groups

Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events

401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program

Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst, Audience & Lifecycle
Description:
Classmates.com has spent 30 years helping people reconnect with meaningful parts of their past. The demand has endured, the data has compounded, and the opportunity now is to become much more intelligent about how we create personalized experiences for individual members, graduating classes, and communities connected by shared history.




We’re looking for a systems thinker who can work from source eventing through business decisions. You’ll help shape the data inputs, define and activate audiences, design experiments, analyze results, and work with leaders across Marketing, Product, BI/Data, and Engineering to turn evidence into better customer experiences.




This is hands-on work across large-scale consumer data and production activation systems. You’ll work directly in Snowflake and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, where the quality of the data, audience logic, experiment design, and interpretation all matter because the resulting decisions affect millions of real consumers.




Local area candidates are encouraged to apply, and please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship, visa transfer, or corp-corp arrangements.

Responsibilities
Build, validate, and operate audience segmentation and activation workflows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud across lifecycle programs.
Work directly with large-scale behavioral, lifecycle, transactional, engagement, and event data in Snowflake to identify meaningful audience patterns and opportunities.
Help shape the source eventing and data inputs needed to answer important customer and business questions, partnering closely with Product, BI, and Engineering.
Design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and use what we learn to continuously improve audience strategy, lifecycle experiences, and personalization.
Build clear reporting and communicate findings to leaders so evidence can move quickly into decisions, operational rules, and better product experiences.




Skills and Experience 
5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience supporting production lifecycle programs, including audience segmentation and activation.
Strong experience in lifecycle marketing analytics, audience segmentation, and marketing automation operations.
Meaningful experience in consumer marketing or consumer product environments, working with individual customer behavior and lifecycle signals at scale.
Advanced SQL skills and strong hands-on Snowflake experience working directly with large customer datasets.
Strong analytical and reporting capability, including the ability to investigate ambiguous problems, validate data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly to business and technical leaders.
Hands-on experience designing and evaluating experiments, including incrementality, statistical testing, or other rigorous measurement approaches.
Curious, driven, and energized by solving ambiguous, high-impact problems with smart, collaborative people.

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $185,000 - $245,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

Title: Compliance Analytics Senior Analyst
Description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

The Compliance Analytics Senior Analyst serves as a critical connector between Compliance and Data Analytics. This role transforms data into actionable insights to strengthen the company’s AML, Sanctions, and Consumer compliance programs. In this role you will lead the development and enhancement of compliance analytics capabilities, dashboards, and automated reporting to improve risk assessments, monitoring, and decision-making.

Operating as an individual contributor with a high degree of autonomy, you will help shape the analytics strategy within Compliance, support priorities across teams, and drive alignment, efficiency, and innovation in compliance data management.

This is an opportunity to proactively shape how data drives compliance excellence. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and proactive risk management and you’ll help bridge the gap between regulatory compliance and advanced analytics.

What you’ll do:

Strategic & Analytical Support



Work closely with Compliance stakeholders to analyze key risks and data requirements across AML, sanctions, and consumer compliance programs.
Apply analytical techniques to enhance compliance program effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Leverage hands-on data engineering expertise to enhance data quality, accessibility, and integration for compliance use cases.
Build and maintain automated data pipelines using dbt orchestration and GitLab for CI/CD workflows to support compliance analytics and reporting.



Analytical Insights Generation



Self-starter with experience in generating analytically driven and actionable insights that inform strategic decision making.
Translate complex compliance requirements into data-driven insights, metrics, and visualizations to inform risk assessments and strategic decisions.



Analytics Development & Automation



Lead the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting tools that track compliance metrics and risk indicators.
Build analytical efficiency tools and processes that support early identification of compliance risks and trends.
Continuously improve existing reporting mechanisms by leveraging automation, machine learning, and advanced analytics where appropriate.



Ownership & Execution



Proactive self-starter with exceptional attention to detail, capable of driving results and operating with minimal direction and support.
Thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while setting goals and tackling complex compliance and data challenges.
Communicate analytical findings effectively to senior management, regulatory partners, and cross-functional teams.



What you’ll need:



Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
6+ years of experience in compliance analytics, risk analytics, or a similar data-driven compliance function (e.g., AML, consumer compliance, operational risk).
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Passion for uncovering hidden patterns, identify trends and emerging risks and opportunities using data
Experience with data transformation and orchestration tools (e.g., dbt) and version control/CI/CD practices (e.g., GitLab).
