Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, will deliver low-latency broadband internet worldwide. As an Business Operations Analyst within the Starlink program, you will develop advanced insights and actionable data to advise internal business leaders on critical trends and operational needs for the company’s enterprise and government teams. You will create high-impact, efficient, and economical solutions by transforming complex internal data into clear, strategic recommendations.

We are looking for strategic thinkers with a passion for data-driven decision-making. You will lead internal initiatives to analyze operational performance, identify emerging trends, and build powerful narratives that guide leadership on resource allocation, process optimization, and long-term planning. You will create and maintain sophisticated dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key internal metrics across commercial, engineering, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain functions. Ideal team members are highly analytical professionals from strategy consulting or investment banking backgrounds who excel in flexible environments, are extremely proficient with Excel, data analysis, dashboards, and PowerPoint, and bring credibility, clarity, and smart decision-making to our internal stakeholders and leadership teams.

Develop and maintain advanced data analysis tools, interactive dashboards, and tracking systems to analyze operational performance, historical trends, and emerging patterns across Starlink Aviation internal processes and functions

Anticipate and identify operational challenges and opportunities through rigorous data analysis, determine root causes, and develop data-backed solutions for immediate mitigation as well as long-term strategic improvement and prevention

Take complex internal data sets and build insightful, powerful narratives using Excel, dashboards, and PowerPoint to communicate findings, trends, and recommendations to internal business leaders and stakeholders

Partner with cross-departmental internal teams (including commercial, finance, industrial design, engineering, application software, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain) to gather data, synchronize efforts, and create tight internal feedback loops for continuous operational improvement

Partner with all levels of leadership within the organization to develop and review potential projects, steer allocation of improvement resources, and ensure sustainability of implemented solutions based on data-driven insights

Manage analytical projects and execute to tight timelines while effectively communicating to and influencing internal stakeholders

Codify knowledge and best practices of internal systems and processes, actively ensuring these documents and practices are updated and maintained

Drive positive business outcomes across disciplines including commercial, engineering, production, test, inventory, quality, and supply chain by delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, mathematics, economics, or a STEM field

3+ years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, operations

Preferred Skills And Experience

Background in strategy consulting or investment banking industry

Extremely proficient with Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, VBA/macros), data analysis, building interactive dashboards, and PowerPoint

Proven ability to take complex data sets and build insightful and powerful narratives that drive decision-making

Strong track record of creating credibility with internal stakeholders and senior leadership through data-driven insights and presentations

Experience driving cross-functional change within large organizations

Strong project management skills and ability to lead projects that require influencing without authority

Experience applying structured analytical and process improvement methodologies

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make compelling presentations to engineers, team members, and management

Proven ability to build efficient analytics pipelines and applications in Excel and dashboard tools

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Intelligence
Description:
The Sr Analyst, Workforce Intelligence serves as the analytics and insights partner to Fortive Talent Partners and OpCo HR teams. The role transforms employee listening, workforce, talent, organization, and work data into actionable insights and recommendations, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve the speed, scale, and quality of insight generation, enabling, better talent, workforce, and organizational decisions.

The role is responsible for Fortive's employee listening strategy and workforce intelligence capability, including the processes, methodologies, reporting, and resources that support enterprise and OpCo decision-making. Through analysis of workforce trends, employee sentiment, organizational effectiveness, skills, automation, and future workforce needs, the role helps Talent Partners, HRBPs, and leaders identify risks, evaluate options, and prioritize actions.

OPERATING MODEL

1 EMPLOYEE LISTENING & EXPERIENCE INSIGHT

2 PEOPLE & ORGANIZATION INTELLIGENCE

3 GOVERNANCE, PRODUCTS & ENABLEMENT

Own the listening strategy and convert employee feedback into potential action.

Connect people, work, organization, and technology data to illuminate decisions.

Create scalable standards, resources, and clear enterprise service commitments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE & OPERATING MODEL


Establish and continuously improve Fortive's Workforce Intelligence operating model, including services, governance, delivery standards, and stakeholder expectations.
Define and deliver a clear portfolio of workforce intelligence products, insights, resources, and support for Talent Partners and HRBPs.
Develop scalable methodologies, tools, and self-service resources that strengthen data-driven decision making across Fortive, including AI-enabled intelligence products and analytical approaches that improve insight generation, pattern detection, forecasting.
Partner with HR Technology, HR Operations, and data owners to improve data quality, usability, and reporting effectiveness.


EMPLOYEE LISTENING & ORGANIZATIONAL INSIGHT


Own Fortive's employee listening strategy, including listening priorities, survey and pulse programs, governance, reporting, and insight generation.
Partner with VP, Talent Planning & Capability as well as Talent Partners to identify critical workforce questions and translate business needs into focused listening and analytical plans.
Analyze employee sentiment, engagement, retention, organizational health, and workforce trends to identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.
Translate complex findings into practical recommendations that enable Talent Partners and HRBPs to take targeted action with business leaders.


WORKFORCE & ORGANIZATION ANALYTICS


Generate enterprise and OpCo insights across workforce, talent, skills, succession, mobility, performance, and employee experience data.
Provide Talent Partners and HRBPs with data-driven recommendations that inform talent reviews, workforce planning, succession discussions, organizational effectiveness, and capability decisions.
Apply AI-enabled and advanced analytical techniques to synthesize structured and unstructured workforce data, identify emerging patterns and risks, develop scenarios, and generate decision-relevant insights.
Analyze organization and work patterns to inform organization design, workforce productivity, automation, AI adoption, and capability planning.
Integrate multiple data sources into dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses that enable better talent, workforce, and business decisions.


SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

OWNS

INFLUENCES

DOES NOT OWN


Enterprise employee listening strategy
Workforce Intelligence methods, standards, resources, and service commitments
Analytical quality, interpretation, validation, and responsible use of AI-enabled workforce intelligence methods
Employee experience and organizational effectiveness priorities
Workforce, organization design, automation, and capability choices
Talent, workforce planning, and action priorities
Data and technology requirements
Employee listening platforms or HR technology
OpCo talent, workforce, or organization strategy
Business staffing, organization design, or automation decisions
Enterprise HR data governance outside the role's scope
Leaders’ accountability for workforce and employee outcomes


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational research, analytics, data science, economics, human resources, or a related discipline preferred.
8+ years of experience in data analytics with a preference for people or workforce analytics, employee listening, organizational research, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience managing employee listening or survey programs preferred, as well as translating quantitative and qualitative findings into practical action.
Strong analytical capability, including statistical analysis, trend identification, data visualization, and integration of multiple forms of evidence.
Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled analytical tools and methods to workforce or business questions, combined with the judgment to validate outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive information, and ensure responsible human oversight.
Experience developing executive-level dashboards, reports, and decision-support materials that make complex topics clear and actionable.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, project management, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and diverse HR partners.
Experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed environment and handling sensitive workforce and employee information with sound judgment and discretion.

Job Description :

The Data Analyst II role is to deliver a final business solution to the operations team through a Power Bi experience. The Data Analyst's technical skills will be put to the test as they shape data into a crispy design through a smooth user experience. Over time the Data Analyst will become a domain expert of supply chains and their use cases. This position will work on cutting edge data technology as a key user on Ryder's Azure Data Lake driving the analytics initiatives. Design critical analytical dashboards, reports and queries to drive strategic business decisions, ad-hoc analysis and identify descriptive and prescriptive solutions for internal Ryder teams and external customers. Dig deep into the core issues of business problems in order to drive a solution that gets at the heart of the causative problem. On this team, the Data Analyst will get the chance to be the expert of supply chain solutions, collaborating with Data Analysts and Scientists, using all the skills in order to exploit data to drive the business forward. This will push the envelope of what is possible within the big data space; streaming live data into a data lake and experimenting with data in the data sandbox.

Essential Functions


Develop Dashboards by understanding business needs, interpret the integrated data and translate this into usable visualizations to drive business decisions, interpreting results and how to utilize the dashboards
Engage the business, evaluating their needs and ad-hoc requests to prioritize product efforts creating new innovative solutions.
Knowledge of the Ryder Business, understanding the complexity of the supply chain world and the role that data has within this ecosystem.
Enhance data maturity and integration to standardize the core value add functionality enabling a multiplier effect.


Additional Responsibilities


Performs other duties as assigned.


Skills And Abilities


Experience developing BI solutions with tools like:
Power BI
Tableau
Exposure using tools like:
ETL tools (Alteryx or SSIS)
Data manipulation tools (SQL)
Object oriented development stacks (.net) (preferred)
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms.
Support product innovation, working closely with technology throughout the build, test, and release of the product using agile methodologies.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required Supply Chain, Data Analytics or equivalent.
Master's degree preferred Supply Chain, Data Analytics, MBA or equivalent
Two (2) years or more Applied Project(s) Experience: Experience in demonstrating, digital transformation, data management in an educational/project or intern type environment required.

Title: Power BI Developer / Business Analytics Consultant
Description:
Infosys is seeking a Power BI Developer / Business Analytics Consultant to support executive reporting, business proposal analytics, and enterprise dashboard development initiatives across Americas operations. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in business intelligence, Power BI, data visualization, KPI development, reporting automation, and analytics-driven decision support within aerospace and manufacturing environments.

The candidate will work closely with business leaders, proposal teams, operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop executive dashboards, automate business reporting, and deliver actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. You will be instrumental in transforming complex business data into meaningful visualizations, standardized KPI frameworks, and scalable reporting solutions.

You will design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and analytics platforms while driving reporting standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will also support leadership reviews, business performance tracking, forecasting, and proposal analytics programs that contribute to organizational growth and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

Candidate can be located anywhere in the U.S. This position will require travel to project locations as needed.


Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent from an accredited institution in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field required. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
Minimum 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, dashboard development, or related fields.
Strong experience designing and developing enterprise dashboards and executive reporting solutions.
Experience automating business reporting processes and implementing scalable analytics solutions.
Experience working with business stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and performance metrics.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data visualization, and business intelligence best practices.
Experience presenting analytical findings and business recommendations to leadership teams.
Ability to standardize reporting methodologies and KPI frameworks across business functions.


Technical Expertise


Advanced Microsoft Excel.
Power BI Dashboard Development.
SQL Development and Data Analysis.
Tableau Reporting and Visualization.
Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.
KPI Development and Performance Measurement.
Forecasting and Predictive Analysis.
Data Storytelling and Executive Reporting.
Reporting Automation and Process Optimization.
Business Performance Analytics.


Key Responsibilities


Develop executive reporting and business proposal metrics dashboards.
Automate existing business proposal reporting processes and workflows.
Design and implement Power BI dashboards supporting Americas operations.
Develop reporting solutions similar to successful analytics programs delivered for major aerospace customers.
Standardize KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and dashboard formats across the organization.
Analyze operational and business performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, advanced analytics, and scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across dashboards and reporting platforms.


Industry Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:


Aerospace Industry
Manufacturing Operations
Proposal Management and Business Development
RFQ-to-Award Analytics
Business Performance Reporting
Executive Management Reporting
Operations Analytics
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience working with large data sets and multiple reporting sources.
Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting aerospace or manufacturing organizations.
Experience building RFQ-to-Award performance reporting and proposal analytics dashboards.
Knowledge of KPI framework design and executive scorecard development.
Experience implementing enterprise-wide reporting standardization initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
Experience supporting strategic planning, forecasting, and operational reviews.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple reporting initiatives simultaneously.
Experience with data governance and reporting best practices..


The job entails sitting as well as working at a computer for extended periods of time.

Should be able to communicate by telephone, email, and face-to-face. Travel may be required as per business and project requirements.

Note


In order to comply with legal requirements, this role is limited to “U.S. persons” as defined by 22 C.F.R.
120.15. U.S. persons include U.S. citizens, U.S. Lawful Permanent Residents, and certain refugees and asylees.
Candidates must be willing to work in rotational shifts, as the role may involve combination of regular shifts and off shift support needs as they arise


Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits:-


Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts
Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal)
401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

Title: Data Scientist I
Description:
Brief Description

Position: Data Scientist I

Location: JBLM, WA

Work Environment: Onsite

Clearance Required: Secret is required to be considered; the position requires the selected candidate to obtain a TS/SCI if they have not already obtained that level of clearance.

Status: Funded

Salary Range: $80,000 - $90,000

Knowesis is looking for a Data Scientist I to support the United States Special Operations Command Preservation of the Force and Family (USSOCOM POTFF) program in identifying and implementing innovative, valuable solutions across the Special Operations Forces (SOF) enterprise aimed at improving the short and long-term well-being of SOF warriors and their families. The Data Scientist I will support all POTFF domains, providing consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data relating to POTFF programs and initiatives.

This position requires a TOP-SECRET/SCI clearance and U.S. Citizenship (applicants without proof of U.S. citizenship will not be considered due to the position’s security clearance requirement).

This position requires on-site work for all or a portion of the work being performed. The successful candidate will reside in the local area or relocate within 15 days of the start date. No relocation is authorized.

The Job Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:


Conducts data analytics, data manipulation, data mining, exploratory analysis, predictive analysis, and statistical analysis, and uses scientific techniques to correlate data into graphical, written, visual, and verbal narrative products, enabling more informed analytic decisions.
Enter and analyze data within government systems. Aggregate data sets across numerous applications and develop trend analysis. Create products demonstrating these trends.
Modify and update existing data sources to provide relevant program related outcome metrics.
Maintain dashboards to automate data analysis, identifying, interpreting, and presenting trends, designed to record POTFF-related programmatic data.
Assist the POTFF staff with survey design. Create, analyze, and report survey data.
Provide consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data related to POTFF programs and initiatives.
Work in consultation with POTFF program staff and the Government’s POTFF biostatistician.
Provide subject matter expertise in the areas of program evaluation, research methodologies, and data analysis.
Be able to use statistics/modeling tools and data visualization techniques to provide an accessible way to see and understand trends, outliers, and patterns in data to produce reports and presentations that accurately convey data trends supporting the mission.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in quantitative science, social science, or a related discipline.
Basic proficiency with the suite of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Access.
Basic proficiency with commonly used statistical software applications such as SPSS, SAS, Python, and R-Shiny.
Be able to read, write, and speak English fluently and clearly to effectively communicate with all personnel they will interact with.
Possess excellent verbal, written, interpersonal communication, presentation skills, and shall be highly detail oriented.
Possess sufficient initiative, interpersonal relationship skills, and social sensitivity such that they can relate constructively to a variety of contacts from diverse backgrounds.


Preferred Qualifications


Certification or documented experience with Human Performance.
Experience working with Special Operations, athletics/sports, or other military settings.
Strong technical and analytical skills in the following:
SQL Server, Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), Python, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate
Knowledge of ETL/ELT development, dimensional data modeling, data governance, machine learning, statistical analysis, NLP, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented workflows, and data pipeline orchestration.
Experience supporting enterprise analytics, dashboard development, predictive modeling, and low-code automation solutions in Microsoft and cloud-based data environments preferred.

Benefits


Health (PPO & HDHP) Insurance, Dental, Vision, STD & LTD, Basic Life Insurance, 401k Company Match, & Voluntary Products.


Knowesis is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on merit and qualifications. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment as required by Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and other applicable federal laws. Our company values all applicants and employees and fosters a work environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

Title: Senior Legal Business Intelligence Advisor
Description:
Overview

At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours. Ready to write your story?

Join MoFo as a SENIOR LEGAL BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE ADVISOR in our Seattle office!

https://www.mofo.com/offices

About The Role

Develop, implement, and support business intelligence, data analytics, and reporting solutions for legal matters and strategic client initiatives. Work closely with attorneys, clients, eDiscovery professionals, and other stakeholders to translate complex legal and business requirements into actionable insights and scalable analytical workflows. Serve as a subject matter resource for data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making.

Business Intelligence and Data Analytics


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and scorecards for legal, financial, operational, and matter data.
Analyze large and complex datasets and perform ad hoc analysis in response to client, attorney, and leadership requests.
Develop and standardize key performance indicators, metrics, visual templates, and reporting conventions.
Develop self-service analytics capabilities that consolidate data, dashboards, and documentation for stakeholder use.
Replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting with automated solutions and quantify the resulting impact.


Data Management and Technical Solutions


Develop and optimize data models, queries, integrations, and ETL/ELT processes using SQL and comparable tools.
Work with technology teams and data owners to integrate disparate systems into reliable analytical datasets.
Establish data definitions, business rules, lineage, and quality controls, and resolve data-quality issues proactively.
Follow structured development and change-management practices, including development, test, and production promotion.
Develop solutions in accordance with firm technology, security, confidentiality, and data governance requirements.


Legal and Client Analytics


Partner with attorneys and legal professionals to translate matter and client objectives into analytical requirements.
Develop analytics for matter activity, litigation and discovery metrics, financial performance, and resource utilization.
Analyze outside counsel and vendor spend to surface cost trends, budget variances, and optimization opportunities.
Develop customized reporting for strategic clients and extend successful solutions to additional matters and firm functions.
Prepare executive-ready summaries and KPI scorecards for firm and client senior leadership.


Artificial Intelligence and Innovation


Evaluate and apply emerging analytics, automation, and generative AI capabilities to appropriate use cases.
Develop AI-assisted workflows for classification, pattern identification, anomaly detection, and reporting.
Identify opportunities for responsible use of AI while maintaining appropriate human oversight and validation.


Consulting and Process Improvement


Serve as a technical and analytical consultant to attorneys, clients, eDiscovery professionals, and firm leadership.
Translate open-ended business questions into defined analytical requirements, project plans, and technical solutions.
Develop documentation, standards, and training materials for analytical tools and solutions.


About You

Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree required, preferably in business analytics, data science, computer science, economics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Four or more years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data engineering, or legal operations analytics.
Experience designing and deploying enterprise business intelligence solutions for legal, financial, or other data-intensive functions.
Experience translating open-ended requirements from non-technical stakeholders into defined analytical solutions.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency with SQL, including window functions, common table expressions, and query optimization.
Strong experience with enterprise business intelligence platforms such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight.
Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and relational and dimensional data models, including star schema design.
Working proficiency with Python, R, or a comparable language for automation and statistical analysis.
Knowledge of data quality, governance, lineage, business rules, and analytical documentation practices.


Preferred


Advanced degree in business analytics, data science, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience with legal operations data, including outside counsel spend and matter analytics, in professional services or a similarly regulated environment.
Experience building self-service analytics platforms for large groups of non-technical stakeholders.
Experience developing AI agents, LLM-enabled automation, or prompt-engineered workflows in production.
Experience with cloud data platforms and transformation tooling such as Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, or dbt.


About Mofo

At MoFo, we collaborate as one firm, across borders, practice areas, and business functions and value fresh ideas and innovation over conformity and competition.


About Us: https://www.mofo.com/about
Inclusion + Engagement: https://www.mofo.com/community/we-at-mofo
Commitment to Pro Bono: https://www.mofo.com/community/pro-bono
The MoFo Foundation: https://www.mofo.com/culture/mofo-foundation


About Our Benefits

MoFo offers a comprehensive benefits package starting on your first day.


A variety of options for medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage to meet the needs of you and your family.
Industry-leading parental leave and family benefits including adoption and fertility treatment options and backup child and elder care.
Global wellness program, including free access to Talkspace and Calm apps.
Annual community service day to make an impact on your community and a birthday holiday just for fun.
Education reimbursement annually.
Dedicated Talent Development team.
Competitive annual profit-sharing contribution.


Where required by law, salary ranges are stated below. Additional compensation may include a discretionary bonus, overtime as applicable, health/welfare benefits, retirement contributions, paid holidays, and PTO. The range displayed is specifically for positions performed in those cities/states and may vary based on factors including but not limited to the following: local market data and ranges; an applicant's skills and prior relevant experience; and certain degrees, licensing, and certifications. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances.

Seattle salary range: $156k to $218k

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Analytics & Transformation
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL

Title: Sr Business Data Analyst
Description:
The Sr Business Data Analyst role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase General Bonus Plan and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.



Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks



Required Experience



Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
Extensive experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
Proficiency in writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
Experience designing and managing data pipelines and working with diverse data sources, required
Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data modeling techniques, and modern analytics trends, required
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required



Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Titan Technologies, LLC (Titan) is seeking an experienced, self-directed, Senior Data Analyst to support the Special Operations Forces Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) III contract. As a member of our team, you will help to assist USSOCOM, Service Component Commands, Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOC), and deployed forces in the delivery of a full spectrum of Information Technology (IT) services to operate and maintain information flow, communications, and connectivity globally.




The Data Analyst – Senior is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.




The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence (BI) tools, and basic programming to extract and transform data from multiple environments.




Duties and Responsibilities:

Collect, clean, transform, and analyze large data sets from multiple sources to identify trends and support decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or other BI platforms.
Work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and design user-friendly reports and data visualizations.
Write queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
Support the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
Contribute to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
Document data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
Collaborate with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
Ensure compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.




You MUST have:

Education & Experience: High school diploma with a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, 10 years experience with Associate's, OR 6 years experience with Bachelor's.
Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or higher is required.
Technical Experience
Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst serves as a key resource for business intelligence, performance and operational analysisfor Central Health. Under general direction of the Central Health's Analytics Quality Manager, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for organizing, analyzing and reporting on data from large clinical, financial, and enrollment datasets. They will also assist in the design and development of data warehouses, performance dashboards and other systems that support the needs of an integrated network of physicians, safety net providers and hospitals to advance care that is patient centered and data driven. This analyst will act as an Epic subject matter expert for front/back-end Epic reporting development.

Remote = Individuals in this position may work at an approved off-site location; however, they may be required to occasionally visit an on-site location in Austin, Texas.

Essential Functions


Collect and document business requirements for reporting and analysis initiatives with customers, which includes gathering, formatting and analyzing clinical, claims, eligibility, financial and other data from various sources to develop reports and dashboards.
Serve as an Analytics and Reporting lead on assigned projects.
Perform quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis and prepare results to share with internal and external customers.
Aid in design and development of data warehouse/data mart applications.
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for multiple stakeholders including clinical, operations, finance, planning, strategy, reimbursement and other Central Health teams.
Collaborate with IT (Joint Technologies) when necessary to automate reporting and to troubleshoot data issues.
Utilize SQL or other advanced analytic tools to perform data extract, integration and query functions. Identify and troubleshoot data anomalies and irregularities.
Work closely with Epic Business Intelligence Director to identify potential solutions for various reporting needs.
Builds SlicerDicer and Reporting Workbench reports and completes Epic Radar setup for custom SQL metrics.
Prepare written and oral reports that communicate necessary information to internal and external customers.
Produce and streamline as needed ongoing monthly, quarterly and annual reports in support of CentralHealth.
Become a data subject matter expert (SME) and understand various sources and applications of Central Health data.



Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Demonstrated ability and desire to lead projects.
Advanced SQL query writing with experience working in a Microsoft SQL Server environment.
Experience developing and troubleshooting programming code (e.g. SAS, R, Python, SQL).
Uses statistics to problem solve and perform moderately complex data analysis and validation.
Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects with varying deadlines.
Complies with data confidentiality and security procedures.
Demonstrated advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Worked in a data cloud warehouse environment such as Snowflake.
Possesses a good understanding of healthcare data infrastructure including the creation of data pipelines and ETL processes in general.
Willingness to learn and work with new programming languages and analytics tools for extracting, manipulating and analyzing data.
Ability to write and speak clearly, easily communicating complex ideas and findings to different audiences.
Knowledge of healthcare, including medical claims coding, relationships between health plans, providers, and payers, a plus.
Demonstrates a strong curiosity and a deep-seated drive to solve complex problems.
Capable of discerning when a solution is sufficient to meet reporting needs.
Experience with healthcare data governance processes.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on validation and accuracy.



MINIMUM EDUCATION


High School Diploma or equivalent with an additional 5 years' experience in a related field (healthcare, statistics, experimental research, data science, economics or public health) will be considered in lieu of degree /
Bachelor's Degree Management Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.



PREFERRED EDUCATION


Master's Degree Master’s degree in Management Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.



MINIMUM EXPERIENCE


3 years of experience in healthcare, statistics, experimental research, data science, reporting and analytics, economics, or public health.
3 years experience in SQL (preferably T-SQL) or Python scripting with an advanced level of expertise.
3 years experience with MS Excel with an advanced level of expertise.
2 years experience in Tableau or other data visualization tool
2 years experience in report development within Epic EMR using Slicer/ Dicer, RWB, Clarity or Caboodle.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSURE

Epic Cogito Certification within 6 Months

Title: Rural Health Data Analyst
Description:
At the Illinois Primary Health Care Association, we educate, empower and advocate for Illinois’ community health centers so every person across the state can access the cutting-edge, compassionate care they need. We are searching for a Rural Health Data Analyst to support rural healthcare transformation initiatives through data collection, analysis, reporting, and performance measurement.




This position works with rural healthcare providers and internal teams to translate healthcare data into actionable insights that improve quality outcomes, support population health management, strengthen program evaluation efforts, and inform strategic decision-making. The Rural Health Data Analyst assists with developing dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, identifying trends, and ensuring data integrity across multiple healthcare and grant-funded initiatives.




Duties:

• Collect, validate, clean, and analyze healthcare and programmatic data from multiple sources, including:

o Electronic Health Records (EHRs)

o Practice Management Systems

o Health Information Exchanges (HIEs)

o Claims and billing systems

o Population health platforms

o Surveys and program databases

• Analyze healthcare utilization, quality metrics, and operational performance indicators.

• Identify trends, patterns, disparities, and opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct ad hoc analyses to support program initiatives and organizational decision-making.

• Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports for leadership, stakeholders, and participating organizations.

• Create interactive dashboards and visualizations using reporting and business intelligence tools.

• Work with the project evaluation team to ensure data reporting supports programmatic needs.

• Monitor key metrics such as:

o Clinical quality measures

o Preventive screening rates

o Chronic disease outcomes

o Behavioral health integration measures

o Access and utilization metrics

o Value-based performance measures

• Present findings in a clear and understandable manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support data reporting requirements for state and federal programs.

• Provide comparative analysis using project specific metrics and the Uniform Data System (UDS)

annual reports.

• Support program evaluations and continuous quality improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with Rural Health Practice Transformation Coach and other program staff to

monitor project progress.

• Provide technical assistance regarding data interpretation and reporting.

• Develop educational materials, toolkits, and resources.

• Build strong relationships with healthcare providers, administrators, and community partners.




Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Statistics,

Data Science, Computer Science, Epidemiology, or related field. Preference given to graduate

level applications.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in healthcare data analysis, reporting or program

evaluation.

• Experience working with healthcare datasets and reporting systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data Visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.




Valued Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Knowledge of healthcare quality improvement and population health concepts.

• Understanding of healthcare data structures and clinical workflows.

• Ability to interpret healthcare regulations and reporting requirements.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

• Knowledge of HIPAA and data privacy requirements.




Other Necessary Skills and Abilities:

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced diverse workplace in a team environment.

• Must be able to present a business image to people who have diverse interests and ideas.

• Must be able to travel and attend meetings as requested, including some overnight stays.

• Must be able to work independently.

• Must have a valid Illinois driver’s license.

• Must be able to use your own automobile and have all liability and other automobile insurance

as required by law.




Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work is performed in a normal office environment with remote working options available. While performing the duties of this job employee will be sitting at a desk for extended periods of time. May be required to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Employee assistance program

Health insurance

Life insurance

Parental leave

Retirement plan
Vision insurance

Title: Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst - eCommerce Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. As Data Analyst – eCommerce Analytics, your primary responsibility will be to extract actionable insights from data to optimize ecommerce performance with insights from site content, promotions, customer behavioral data, marketing strategies, and market data, just to name a few. You will collaborate with ecommerce product management, category management, and site operations teams to drive data-driven decisions. The primary goal is providing insights for the ecommerce and marketing teams to guide, monitor and measure their strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Collection: Partner with operations to track customer actions on the website through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.
Data Analysis: Dive deep into customer behavior data in Google Analytics, sales data in Snowflake, and aggregated data in Power BI dashboards to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to increase conversion, average order value, and traffic.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in ecommerce or analytics.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is required.
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights effectively using Power BI, Tableau or similar tools (Power BI is Preferred)


Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.

Title: Data Analyst 1 - MULTI
Company: New York State Department of Health
Description:
Description

Duties Description

The Office of Health Insurance Programs in the Division of Data Services & Analytics, in The Bureau of Data Insights and Research is currently seeking three Data Analysts 1 to support the work in various units located within the Bureau.

The Data Analyst 1 works with business units to develop and build models in support of analytic use cases; drafts technical requirements and data definitions; provides input on current approaches and recommends improvements to best achieve goals; reviews and suggests improvements to current or planned systems and processes; performs data extraction, aggregation, and quality checks from multiple sources and tables in support of trend identification and root cause analysis; summarizes results, creates written reports and collaborates with staff to develop business intelligence solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Data analytics, deliverables, and summarized reports using the Medicaid Data Warehouse.

SQL review of others’ work including ad-hoc, budget, and recurring requests.

Predictive modeling.

Provide customer service to program representatives and collaborate with stakeholders across the Division and The Office of Health Insurance Programs as it relates to both business and data domains.

Act as a subject matter expert for databooks; including but not limited to, creation, review, backlog maintenance, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Ensure proper use of databooks by stakeholders to help inform budget and policy decisions, provide necessary training in the use of databooks.

Tableau visualizations for trend analysis.

Fiscal analysis for ad-hoc requests, and budget inquiries.

Audit support.

Assist in creation and review of design documents.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Four years of experience* in data visualization, and statistical models and data mining tools and satisfactory completion of a two-year traineeship; OR six years of experience* in data visualization, and statistical models and data mining tools.


Substitution: An associate’s degree may substitute for two years of general experience; or a bachelor’s degree may substitute for four years of general experience. A master’s degree in data or computer science, informatics, economics, statistics, mathematics, or a related field, may substitute for one year of general experience; or a Ph.D. in these fields may substitute for two years of general experience.


Preferred Qualifications: Experience in Medciaid (New York Medicaid preferred), experience in SQL and Tableau; Experience working with large-scale data warehouses, Experience in reporting environments

Additional Comments

When reviewing qualifications, omissions and vagueness cannot be interpreted in the candidate’s favor. Candidates are responsible for providing accurate and clear descriptions of their experience demonstrating how they meet the minimum qualifications.

We offer a work-life balance and a generous benefits package, worth 65% of salary, including:


Holiday & Paid Time Off
Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)
Pension from New York State Employees’ Retirement System
Shift & Geographic pay differentials
Affordable Health Care options
Family dental and vision benefits at no additional cost
NYS Deferred Compensation plan
Access to NY 529 and NY ABLE College Savings Programs, and U.S. Savings Bonds
And many more...

2000 16th St, Denver, Colorado, 80202-5117, United States of America

The Clinical Analytics & Reporting Team is responsible for designing, developing, and overseeing analytical solutions in support of DaVita’s clinical strategy. Our team’s mission is to improve patient quality of life by transforming data into actionable information to guide strategic decisions, support clinical innovation, and inform operating tactics. This position will primarily support the Pharmaceutical Operations (PharmaOps) team.

The Clinical Data Analyst’s primary objective is to partner with diverse teams throughout the enterprise to produce analytical insights that support a broad range of clinical initiatives.

A successful teammate exemplifies personal behaviors in line with DaVita’s core values: service excellence, integrity, team, continuous improvement, accountability, fulfillment, and fun.

Sound like you? Then you might be a great fit for the role of Clinical Data Analyst on DaVita’s Clinical Analytics & Reporting team.

Responsibilities


Create, maintain, and distribute reports related to clinical outcomes, surveillance, and risk mitigation on a regular basis
Utilize SQL and Tableau to manage data in preparation for analysis and/or reporting.
Provide clinical insights and data trends to support and inform a multitude of projects and initiatives across the organization
Present data to and work closely with a variety of stakeholders including senior-level operators and teammates in the clinics
Synthesize results in a non-technical manner to inform recommendations and next steps for leadership
Create cohesive presentations based on findings, summarizing insights from analysis
Act as a collaborative partner during strategy meetings
Become a subject matter expert and thought partner in clinical and methodologic areas
Willing to travel (up to 10% of time)

A bachelor’s degree is required; quantitative fields such as biostatistics, statistics, informatics, computer science, or math are strongly recommended
1-2 years of prior relevant work experience preferred
Demonstrated ability to learn and develop proficiency in general programming skills in any of the following as needed: SQL, Python, R, etc.

Advanced critical thinking, strong work ethic, creative mindset, adept communication skills, attention to detail, design-mindedness, flexibility with change, comfort with ambiguity, efficient time management, technical aptitude, and business acumen

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
General Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Is responsible for retrieving, interpreting, and analyzing data to drive key business decisions and actions, measure program efficacy and contribute to strategic direction. Working with other teams across the Revenue Cycle, participates as a catalyst for maintaining the data life cycle. Focusing on system strategic goals and objectives, assist customers with formulating appropriate data questions that will lead to analyses which will reveal relevant insights. Cleans and prepares data for analysis, ensuring applicability to business need. Engages in data profiling of raw data. Applies appropriate techniques and programming languages (e.g. R, Python, SQL) to identify patterns and trends, while reaching out to senior level analysts for assistance when needed. Assist stakeholders with interpreting results, at times applying visualization techniques (e.g. Microsoft Power BI). Collaborates with developers and end users to ensure technical requirements and specifications reflect appropriate business logic.This position will leverage the analytics spectrum to tell a story with the data, working with senior level analysts to ensure the application of the most appropriate approach for each business need. Applies these approaches to data from various sources, such as relational databases, data warehouses, data marts and tabular data models. Accesses data from third-party vendor tools. This position requires the soft skill of story-telling through data, by turning technical information into easy-to-understand non-technical action items. Confidence in presentation of findings and excellent communication skills are desired. Develops the ability to view business problems from varying perspectives and continuously display curiosity.

Responsibilities

Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Functions


Assist customers with formulating appropriate data questions to meet business and strategic needs.
Ability to take a business question or need and turn it into a data question for the purpose of transforming and analyzing the data to extract an answer to that question.
Retrieve data from one or more sources and prepare the data for analysis.
Engage in data profiling of raw data, including but not limited to, health plan (i.e. claims), electronic health record, and third-party vendor data.
Identify patterns and trends in the data using appropriate techniques and programming languages.
Participate in data exploration activities for the purpose of finding interesting trends or relationships that could bring value to the business.
Develop skill set to create clean, visually compelling charts & visualizations that will help others understand the data and relevant insights.
Support the Revenue Cycle data and analytics strategy, processes, technical architecture, and design of subject areas.
Collaborate with developers and end users to ensure technical requirements and specifications reflect appropriate business logic.
Support system wide data integrity, quality control and standardization as identified by system leaders and/or system level teams


Common Expectations


Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, current literature, in-service meetings, and workshops.
Provides outstanding service to all customers; fosters teamwork; and practices fiscal responsibility through improvement and innovation.


Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Education


High School Diploma or GED Required
Bachelors Degree Preferred


Work Experience


5 years Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, or Computer science or related field Required


Licenses


Certified Health Data Analyst Upon Hire Preferred


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Math, statistical and analysis skills needed;
Demonstrated proficiency with SQL query writing skills required;
Knowledge of data modeling concepts desired;
Experience with R, Python & other languages required;
Strong teamwork/communication/customer service skills.


Benefits Offered


Comprehensive health benefits
Retirement savings plan
Paid time off (PTO)
Education assistance
Financial education and support, including DailyPay
Expanded Paid Parental Leave
