Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst – Pharma & Life Sciences

Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 2–4 years

Compensation: $70,000 – $80,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Pharma analytics sits at the intersection of science and commercial strategy — and it pays for precision. Master syndicated data, real-world evidence, and market-access analytics in one of the few niches where domain knowledge alone can double your market value.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Pharma & Life Sciences to turn commercial, clinical, and real-world data into insight. You will build brand and field-force reporting, work with industry-standard syndicated datasets, and deliver analysis that supports launch performance, market access, and compliant decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, clean, and analyze pharma commercial datasets — prescription (Rx), medical/pharmacy claims, and sales data — using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for brand performance, market share, and field-force effectiveness.
Work with syndicated data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, and Komodo Health.
Support real-world evidence (RWE), patient-journey, and payer/market-access analytics.
Handle clinical or regulated data with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 awareness, maintaining data integrity and traceability.
Ensure data quality and compliance across reporting platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to commercial and medical-affairs stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in pharma, biotech, or life sciences.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with pharmaceutical, clinical, or healthcare claims data.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake), Python (pandas, NumPy), SAS.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Syndicated & domain data: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD, LAAD), Symphony Health, Komodo Health, specialty pharmacy data.
Domain systems: Veeva CRM, Salesforce; cloud platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS/Azure data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of HIPAA, GxP, and 21 CFR Part 11 data-compliance concepts.
Familiarity with patient-level data (PLD), longitudinal claims, or HCP/HCO master data (MDM).
Exposure to launch analytics, forecasting, or incentive-compensation reporting.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Title: CX Data Analyst
Description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

This is a solo role. You won't have a team beneath you. You will need to be fluent enough in support analytics to hold the function independently, confident enough to push back on how metrics are framed, and fast enough to operate at Harvey's pace.

What You'll Do


Own recurring reporting for Customer Experience — weekly, monthly, and QBR-ready — tailored to ops, leadership, and cross-functional audiences
Translate support data into clear narratives: what's happening, why, and what to do about it
Track and maintain north star metrics: cSAT, TTR by tier, QA scores, bug escalation rate to EPD, and First Response Time
Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give the ops team and leadership real-time visibility into support performance
Partner with Support Systems to ensure Zendesk is instrumented to capture the data we need
Work with Harvey's central data team to connect support data to broader product and customer data sources
Identify and close data collection gaps — if we can't measure it, help define how we should
Design feedback loops that connect support signals to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success
Quantify the operational cost of product bugs, feature gaps, and onboarding failures
Contribute to QA analytics as the QA program matures
Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness
Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools
Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders


Required

What You Have


3–5 years of experience in analytics, with at least 2 years directly in support operations, customer success operations, or a closely adjacent function
Fluency in support platform data — you know how Zendesk (or equivalent) is structured, what data it produces, and what it doesn't
SQL proficiency — you can write complex queries against large datasets without hand-holding (CTEs, window functions, joins across schemas)
Dashboard experience — you've built and maintained operational dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Omni, or equivalent
Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly
Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative
Comfort operating solo — you don't need a team around you to deliver, and you don't need a ticket to tell you what to look at


Strong Plus


Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation
Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling
Experience building or contributing to QA analytics programs
Background supporting enterprise SaaS or AI-native products
Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting


Key Attributes


AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier
Pace: you move in hours and days, not weeks. You surface findings before anyone has to ask
Judgment: you know which metrics matter and which are vanity. You push back when framing is wrong
Clarity: your outputs are direct, jargon-free, and actionable. You write for the reader, not yourself
Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process


Compensation

$112,000 - $168,000 USD

Title: Product Data Analyst II
Description:
About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About The Team/role

As a Product Analyst II, you will work hand-in-hand with multiple business departments to develop complex models and effectively communicate their business impacts, ensuring Checkr maintains its leadership position in efficiency, quality, and other key metrics identified by you and pertinent stakeholders.

This pivotal role falls under the Data Platform organization and you will report directly to the Head of Data Platform. Moreover, your strong partnership with Checkr's Product, Financial Planning & Strategy, Data Engineering, and cross-functional business teams will be the key to unlocking their potential through the strategic use of data and be the last mile for translation to impact on business.

What you’ll do:


Partner with business stakeholders to gain deep understanding of our products and customers
Effectively communicate insights and recommendations from your analysis to a non-technical audience across all organizational levels
Collaborate closely with product owners and finance partners to analyze the value of new features, enhancements, and projects
Based on exploratory analysis, create customer profiles, develop metrics to inform pricing and monetization strategies
Develop AI context, evals to enable your business stakeholders to self-serve your data models
Work with engineers to develop data sources and core metrics to be utilized by the entire company
Experimentation Evangelist - educate and promote a data driven culture through experimentation


What you bring:


2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, with at least 1 year in a product analytics/data science role
Advanced proficiency in SQL, as well as an understanding of data warehouse principles including data modeling; Bonus points for experience with dbt
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and prioritize growth opportunities based on data and experiment results
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to distill complex analytical solutions into actionable insights and communicate business impact to non technical audiences
A demonstrated self-starter with excellent prioritization skills, able to drive projects to completion with minimal guidance.
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.


Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$115,000—$135,000 USD

What We Offer


A fast-paced and collaborative environment
Learning and development allowance
Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
Flexible PTO policy
Monthly wellness stipend


At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr

Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.

Title: Business Data Analyst - Video Safety Operations - Trust & Safety
Description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
The Video Safety Operations (VSO) Reports & Insights Team architects diagnostic frameworks and builds automated data solutions to elevate operations performance. Our mission is to sustain a safer video ecosystem via data-driven excellence. We:
- Architect and maintain core metrics, scorecards, and interactive dashboards
- Drive performance through granular targets, root-cause analysis, and automated reporting
- Empower decisions with ad hoc insights, strategic guidance, and actionable business intelligence

Responsibilities:
- Design, update, and implement moderation performance data metrics & attribution frameworks.
- Monitor target completion rates, navigate root causes, and coordinate XFN solutions for performance driving.
- Develop and maintain strategic data dashboards and automation solutions.
- Conduct topic deep-dive analysis to enable cross-functional (XFN) decision making.
- Gather, analyze, and report information related to current support processes contributing to continuous improvement.
- Create customized data analysis tools, applications, and data manipulation utilities for the team. Innovations will include tools providing key metrics across multiple data sources through the consolidation of tools and markets.
- Provide summary reports on various processes, assist in the development of key business suggestions and contribute to weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
- 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business insights enablement, or business intelligence.
- Proficiency in Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI), SQL, Excel, and Statistics.
- Strong ability to independently complete data analyses and deliver actionable, well-reasoned insights.
- Experience in metric system setup, attribution analysis, and target-setting methodologies; ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Familiarity with content moderation operations and strategies, including quality measurement, capacity planning, target setting, and performance scorecard planning.
- Proficiency in Python.

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. About Handshake AI

Handshake AI is the fastest-growing, most critical, and most revenue-generating part of Handshake's business. We power expert-labeled data collection at scale, matching domain experts with leading AI companies to train frontier models—and we're already a top-three player in one of the fastest-growing sectors in AI: human data. We have the opportunity to do for the AI data economy what LinkedIn did for professional networking: become the default platform where the work happens.

Why Join Handshake Now


Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
Work hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions
Join a team with leadership from Scale AI, Meta, xAI, Notion, Coinbase, and Palantir, among others
Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue


About The Role

We’re looking for a highly motivated Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise to support analytics, measurement, and operational insights across our human data training workflows. You’ll work with messy, fast-moving data related to expert performance, task quality, throughput, and overall operational efficiency.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership, close partnership with product and operations, and a steep growth curve for someone who executes well.

What You’ll Do


Write advanced SQL to analyze large, complex datasets related to expert performance, task quality, and operational workflows.
Define, build, and maintain core metrics that measure data quality, throughput, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Partner with Product, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to answer high-impact business and product questions.
Conduct analyses that inform workflow design, task improvements, and operational decision-making.
Build dashboards, reporting, and self-serve analytics that enable fast, informed decisions.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues, then partner with relevant teams to resolve them.
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses and actionable recommendations.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Desired Capabilities


3–5 years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Expert-level SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong analytical judgment and comfort working with imperfect, real-world data.
Experience defining metrics and using data to influence product or business decisions.
High ownership mindset and ability to independently drive complex work forward.
Strong communication skills and comfort partnering cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.


Extra Credit


Python experience for data analysis, such as pandas and notebooks.
Experience supporting operational, marketplace, quality, or workforce-related analytics.
Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or metrics-driven product development.
Exposure to AI data workflows, data labeling, or evaluation processes.
Experience with analytics engineering, including building and maintaining DBT models.

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Title: Sr. Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities


Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it


About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!


5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question


Working Style


Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go


Nice-to-Haves


Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience

Description:
Innovate with purpose

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

Make Your Impact Within a Rapidly Growing Fintech Company

As part of the Product Analytics team, you will be the analytics owner for our Accounts Payable product. Not a role that runs the analyses Product hands you but one that finds the analysis Product did not know to ask for: the metric that is quietly wrong, the automation nobody noticed, the deep dive that changes a roadmap call. You will work directly with Product, Engineering, and AP leadership, with real ownership and executive visibility from day one.

Responsibilities


Set the analytics agenda for AP. Find product opportunities, data gaps, and automation candidates, and bring them to Product as recommendations that shape the roadmap.
Own the AP analytics relationship: metric and OKR definition, a standing review cadence with Product, and a deep-dive practice you drive.
Run experiments and apply causal inference, so recommendations rest on what moved a metric, not on correlation.
Build and maintain production-grade data models in dbt with tests, documentation, and version-controlled workflows.
Build with AI-assisted workflows by default, and automate recurring reporting to free your time for higher-value work.
Drive executive reporting and its adoption across leadership and Product.
Present with confidence to senior stakeholders, and hold your ground when a metric is contested.
Partner with data engineering to validate data quality and metric definitions, and fix documentation-to-logic drift when you find it.


We would love to chat if you have


5+ years in product analytics, data science or a related quantitative field, owning a domain end to end.
A track record of self-directed work: finding high-impact problems and shipping the fix.
Advanced SQL and strong Python.
Production experience with dbt or similar: models, tests, documentation, version-controlled review.
Fluency in experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment is the right tool.
Genuine AI-native fluency. You build with agentic coding tools already, and you know from experience where their output can and cannot be trusted.
The judgment to turn an ambiguous question into a metrics framework, and the spine to defend it.
Data storytelling that turns a complex finding into a decision a product team acts on.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The People Analytics Team

Our People Analytics team distills insights from our data to drive informed workforce decisions across the organization. We partner with stakeholders throughout the business to transform complex people data into actionable intelligence that optimizes the employee lifecycle and supports better business outcomes.

The Staff Data Analyst People Analytics Opportunity

This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead the design and delivery of people analytics solutions that directly impact workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience. You'll develop advanced predictive models, create scalable dashboards, and apply emerging AI technologies to solve complex workforce challenges while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

Analyze and report on the entire employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding through development and exit—by designing dashboards and reports that provide insights into hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, promotions, compensation, headcount, and organizational health
Partner with People Team leaders, stakeholders across the business, and data teams to translate business questions into analytical approaches, ensure data quality and governance, and deliver executive-ready insights
Design, build, and maintain predictive analytics models that identify workforce trends, risks, and opportunities, including attrition prediction, workforce forecasting, employee lifecycle analysis, and talent pipeline analytics
Apply advanced statistical techniques—including regression analysis, clustering, forecasting, survival analysis, and segmentation—to solve complex workforce challenges and inform strategic decision-making
Analyze employee feedback from surveys, onboarding, exit interviews, and other listening channels using Natural Language Processing and text analytics to identify emerging themes and actionable insights
Explore and prototype Generative AI use cases that automate narrative reporting, summarize workforce trends, and enhance decision support while maintaining governance and data privacy standards

What you'll bring to the role

7+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Science, or a related analytics discipline
Advanced proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools, data warehousing platforms, spreadsheet and SQL querying, and enterprise HR platforms
Having experience with our direct tech stack is highly preferred:
Data visualization and reporting: Tableau
Data warehousing: Snowflake
Spreadsheet and querying: Excel, SQL
Enterprise HR platforms: Workday, ServiceNow, Greenhouse
Demonstrated expertise applying advanced statistical methods including regression, clustering, forecasting, and text analytics
Excellent data visualization and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, influence decisions through data, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and automation
Familiarity with Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and other emerging AI technologies applied to analytics
Experience implementing sound data management and governance practices across large, complex datasets

At Uber, People Analytics drives business performance by translating employee insights into action. We partner with senior leaders to improve organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and workforce outcomes across the full talent lifecycle-from hiring to retention.

We are looking for a senior data analyst who is passionate about using data to answer business questions and influence decisions. This role sits at the intersection of business analytics consulting and employee listening, supporting company-wide decisions through data analysis, survey insights, and people metrics.

What You'll Do

Act as an analytics consultant to the business


Partner with stakeholders to quickly understand business questions and translate them into clear, actionable analyses
Deliver timely, high-quality insights that inform decisions on engagement, retention, performance, and organizational health
Balance speed and rigor to support both rapid questions and deeper dives


Drive employee listening insights


Analyze Uber-wide employee survey data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Support survey reporting, interpretation, and storytelling to drive action across teams
Contribute to improving how we measure and understand employee experience


Work with people data at scale


Query, clean, and analyze data from multiple data sources (e.g., HRIS, surveys, behavioral data)
Build survey dashboards, reports, and repeatable analyses that enable self-service and scalable insights


Communicate and influence


Translate data into clear narratives, visualizations, and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Partner with cross-functional teams (HRBPs, leaders) to ensure insights drive action


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative or analytical field (e.g., Economics, Psychology, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related)
Strong SQL expertise with the ability to independently write complex, efficient queries on large datasets
Strong Google Sheets skills
2+ years of experience analyzing data and delivering insights in a business environment
Experience using tools such as Python, R, Tableau or similar for data analysis and visualization


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in people analytics, HR data, or employee listening (survey) analysis
Familiarity with Qualtrics is strongly preferred, including building dashboards in Qualtrics
Experience in statistical modeling and data science
Experience with survey design, measurement, or organizational research concepts
Demonstrated ability to leverage Generative AI tools to automate or augment data analysis and insight generation
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business questions into structured analysis


For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with


Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Role: Sr Data Analyst

Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite – 5 days a week)

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead reporting and analytics efforts across operations. This role will focus on building scalable, accurate reporting, identifying insights from operational data, and enabling data-driven decisions across business and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities


Design and build end-to-end reporting solutions, including dashboards, recurring reports, and ad-hoc analysis aligned to business needs.
Partner with stakeholders across Operations, DQAS, OPCC, and Technology teams to define reporting requirements and KPIs.
Develop and maintain data models and pipelines to support reliable reporting.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Own data quality validation and ensure accuracy across reporting outputs.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
Drive standardization and automation of reporting processes to reduce manual effort.
Support incident analysis by providing data-backed root cause insights.
Collaborate with engineering teams on data sourcing, transformations, and performance optimization.


Required Skills


Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and data validation.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Proficiency in data wrangling and analysis using Python or R.
Experience working with large datasets and data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, Hadoop, or similar technologies.
Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data modeling concepts.
Strong Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis and validation work.
Experience with data quality frameworks and validation techniques.


Preferred Skills


Experience with operational or real-time reporting environments.
Familiarity with railroad, logistics, or transportation data.
Exposure to the Azure data stack, including ADF, Synapse, and Databricks.
Understanding of event-driven systems and streaming data.


Soft Skills


Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.
Ability to work across business and technology teams without formal authority.
Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in data analytics or reporting roles.
Proven experience building enterprise-grade reporting solutions.


The base salary for this position is $ 92,250 to $125,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan

Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do

  • Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
  • Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
  • Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
  • Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
  • Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
  • Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
  • Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements

What We're Looking For

  • 0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
  • Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
  • Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
  • Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
  • High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week

Qualifications

  • Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
  • US Person required.
  • Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity
  • Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
  • Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. 3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets

Title: Data Analyst, Administration & Finance
Description:
Pay Range

The UMass President’s Office expects to pay within an approximate hiring range between $60,000 - $75,000 for this position. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment.

Primary Work Location:

Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query), Python, or R.
Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and reporting best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.



Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


Master’s degree in a related field



Working Conditions


Hybrid work environment. Primarily located at the UMass President’s Office located at 50 Washington St., Westborough, MA with remote work.
Must be able to travel occasionally to all UMass campuses and the Boston central office.



Additional Details

All offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC’s Advanced Energy Strategic Deployment team is seeking a Data Analyst II to support data management, analysis, and reporting across strategic projects that advance the energy sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing metrics and building reports for a variety of projects, with the knowledge and expertise to create, edit, and modify data sets and produce accurate, timely, and clear analytics for the team and our clients.

The ideal candidate is an independent, detail-oriented contributor with a positive attitude who excels at multitasking while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, efficiency, and reliability. They will bring curiosity about emerging tools—including AI—and a desire to apply data analytics, visualization, and geospatial techniques to real-world advanced energy challenges. A sufficient understanding of the energy industry to interpret the data required for the position is preferred.

Why Consider This Job Opportunity?


Advance your career through ongoing learning and development
Maintain a healthy work-life balance with supportive policies
Collaborate within an inclusive and respectful team environment
Contribute to a rapidly expanding and future-focused industry
Support impactful projects driving the clean energy transition


Responsibilities


Provide valuable insight to program teams based on the data collected, enabling informed decision-making.
Build and maintain customized dashboards and reporting for clients, subcontractors, management, and cross-functional team members in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database.
Sort through and interpret high quantities of data, identifying, diagnosing, and correcting discrepancies to ensure accuracy.
Develop data models through reporting and visualization to support decision-making.
Monitor and report program key performance metrics and provide updates to management.
Support program platform tasks, including configuration, dashboards, and data import/export as directed.
Provide input for troubleshooting, process improvements, automation, and system enhancements.
Research and present market intelligence and customer trends to support strategic advanced energy projects.
Explore and pilot AI-enabled and geospatial (GIS) approaches to streamline data-intensive processes and enhance analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Geography/GIS, Engineering, Environmental Studies, a related field, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience performing data analysis and using tools to create reports, dashboards, and data exploration.
Residency in the Denver, Colorado area preferred.
Advanced computer skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams); advanced Excel skills preferred.
Experience with data analysis and visualization software (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Tableau, R, or Python).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong time-management skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to contribute to multiple projects simultaneously with demonstrated accuracy and reliability.
Experience applying AI / machine-learning tools to data analysis, automation, or reporting.
Strong Power BI development skills (data modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards).
Microsoft Enterprise ecosystem experience, including Microsoft Dynamics (a plus), Power Platform, and SharePoint.

Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.

Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities


Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).


Qualifications / Experience Required


Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.
