Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Overview

EA is seeking a Data Analyst II to join our team. In this role, you’ll work with complex education data throughout the analytical process, from integrating and preparing data to applying statistical methods and developing data products. You’ll use data from school districts and state agencies to answer complex analytical, research, and policy questions, build reliable analytical workflows, and create tools and visualizations that support our partners.

You’ll also have opportunities to collaborate across teams and directly with education partners, helping translate complex data, technical, and policy needs into clear and practical solutions. Depending on project needs, you may work with partners to clarify analytical questions, assess relevant data sources, explain technical considerations and findings, and help guide analytical work from initial exploration through delivery.

EA will consider candidates with a range of experience and qualifications for placement at the Data Analyst I, Data Analyst II, or Senior Data Analyst level. The level and responsibilities will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated capabilities. This position is based on-site at EA’s downtown Madison, WI office. Remote work may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience.

Candidates may come from a variety of professional backgrounds. We encourage applicants with experience as Data Analysts, Research Analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, BI Analysts, education data specialists, or in similar roles involving technical data analysis and the development of analytical products to apply.

Requirements


Proficiency with a statistical programming language, such as R or Python. This includes functional programming, commonly used data-processing packages, and the development of clear, maintainable analytical code.
Working proficiency with SQL, including the ability to write, interpret, and debug complex queries in a cloud data warehouse environment, such as Snowflake.
Understanding statistical modeling techniques such as linear regression, logistic regression, and machine learning is desired.
Familiarity with education data standards such as Ed-Fi, or demonstrated ability to learn and apply complex data standards and business rules.
Experience working with business intelligence tools, with Apache Superset preferred.
Comfort working in an evolving technical environment and adopting new tools, including AI-assisted technologies, to improve the efficiency and quality of analytical work.
Experience using Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
Experience with dbt is a plus. Experience with other modern data and analytics tools, such as Databricks, BigQuery, or Looker, is also relevant and welcome.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment with limited direction.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex data, analytical methods, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Qualifications


Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
At least one year of relevant professional experience in a Data Analyst or related role, including progressively independent analytical work.


Compensation And Benefits

The base salary range for the Data Analyst II position is $72,000–$84,000, depending on experience and qualifications. EA may also consider candidates for placement at the Data Analyst I or Senior Data Analyst level; compensation would be adjusted accordingly based on the level at which the candidate is hired.

EA's Benefits Include


A 12% non-elective contribution each payroll from EA to your 401k retirement plan, once eligible per plan rules.
Up to a 3% salary deferral match each payroll by EA to your 401k, once eligible and contributing, per plan rules.
26.5 days of paid vacation annually (accrued at the rate of 17.67 hours per month).
40 hours of paid sick time provided on date of hire plus 8 hours of paid sick time that accrued monthly.
9 paid holidays, including EA-designated holidays or the option to swap holidays of your choosing.
85% of health insurance premium paid for by EA, 50% of dental premiums paid for by EA.
Paid parental leave, after one year of employment and if all other eligibility requirements are met
Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability. Employer-Paid Long-Term Disability.
Employer-Paid Group Life Insurance: Coverage equal to 2x your annual salary, up to $200,000.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential support and resources available to you and your eligible family members.

Title: Data Analyst

1stDibs is a one-of-a-kind online marketplace that connects design lovers to more than one million extraordinary pieces, from furniture and fine art to jewelry and fashion. As a leading global marketplace for design lovers, we enable shoppers to discover beautiful things and engage with top sellers from around the world. We encourage our shoppers to interact with sellers throughout all stages of the transaction, including item inquiries, price negotiations and customization requests.

As a Data Analyst, you will be a foundational architect of our data-driven future. You won't just pull numbers; you will deliver results by uncovering the "why" behind buyer and seller behavior.

What You Will Do


Analyze: Partner cross-functionally to identify trends that guide our global business strategy.
Empower: Design scalable, self-serve dashboards (Looker/Tableau) that help your teammates make faster, smarter decisions.
Optimize: Lead efforts to streamline data collection and translate complex business needs into clear data products.
Experiment: Collaborate with Product and Marketing to run A/B tests that directly influence our user experience.


What You’ll Bring


Experience: 2+ years in data or product analytics.
Technical Toolkit: Proficiency in SQL is required.
Strategic Mindset: An ability to see both the granular details and the "big picture" of a luxury marketplace.
Collaborative Spirit: You thrive when succeeding together and can succinctly exchange ideas with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Education: A degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Econ, Business) or equivalent practical experience
Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States; employer sponsorship is not available. We are not sponsoring H-1B, OPTs, or other visa categories for this role.


Nice To Haves


Familiarity with Python or dbt is a plus; we value your ability to listen and learn new tools.


Our overall compensation package is made of several parts, base compensation being one of them. At 1stDibs we value and are proud of our culture, innovation, professional development and training workshops, trust and giving back to the community. Equity, a comprehensive benefits package, and incentive (IF APPLICABLE) are all are components of your total compensation package. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

$92,000—$123,000 USD

The 1stDibs mission, to enrich lives with the extraordinary, can only be achieved when diversity, equity and inclusion are embedded into our values, culture and the way we do business. Enabling access to and celebrating unique and diverse perspectives is at the very core of what we do. We are committed to attracting and retaining the best talent in the industry, who are reflective of the diversity of our communities, and fostering an environment where every individual feels they belong, are valued and heard. Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
The Medpace Insights & Analytics within Clinical Operations is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The Insights & Analytics team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires interaction and partnership with leadership across the Medpace organization.

What’s in this for you?


Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from visualization to data warehousing;
Grow business knowledge by working with leadership across all aspects of Medpace’s business.


Responsibilities

What’s involved?

We are looking for a Junior Business Intelligence Analyst to add additional depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – from Visualization and Storytelling to SQL, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with leadership, product management, operations, finance, and other technical teams to find opportunities to improve and expand our business.

An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

What you bring to the table – and why we need you!


Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;
Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive BI initiatives (SQL, DAX, Data Modeling, etc.);
Communication Skills - Partner with leadership and collaborate with software engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
0-3 years of experience in business intelligence or analytics within a clinical setting or healthcare– Power BI and advanced SQL preferred;
Strong analytical and communication skills;
Excellent organization skills and the ability to multitask while efficiently completing high quality work.


Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 6,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work


Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture


Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development


Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


Other Employee Benefits


Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports

Cincinnati Headquarters Experience


A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
Free on-site parking
Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities


What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst II - Omni Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands, Inc. is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of menswear, including suits and a broad selection of business casual offerings as well as the largest provider of tuxedo rental products in the U.S. and Canada. We operate retail stores in all 50 states and Canada. Our U.S. retail stores are operated under the brand names of Men’s Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Men’s Wearhouse and Tux, and K&G Fashion. Our Canadian stores are operated under the brand name of Moores in ten provinces. Our purpose is we help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments. We accomplish this by putting customers at the center of every decision, rallying together to achieve common goals, and striving for excellence and continuous improvement. We help fulfill this purpose by valuing differences and knowing they make us better and showing up with courage to always do the right thing. If you want to make a difference, be part of a great team and grow, you might be a perfect fit.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for an Data Analyst II – Omni Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. You will serve as a vital role as a “data detective” investigating trends underlying KPIs to uncover the "why" behind performance. Collaborating with merchandising and ecomm teams, you will go beyond retrospective reporting to identify who is impacted and what it means for our future. Your proactive, forward-looking insights will guide, monitor, and measure key ecomm and merchandising strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Analysis: Dive deep into sales, inventory, and website activity to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Forecasting: Use statistical models to create forward-looking prediction models.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in a similar role
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights in enterprise Business Intelligence tools effectively is required, preferably in Power BI.
AI Tools: Ability to use tools (such as CoPilot and Glean) to amplify, but not replace thinking, in work is required.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is preferred.
Python/R: Proficiency in scripting data manipulation and modeling for analysis is preferred.


Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.


The starting salary for this position is $92,810 – $142,350. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $193,294. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

Note: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with this job.

Description:
1158664_RR00117896 Job ID: 1158664_RR00117896

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu, and interact with us on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Data Analyst (FGP) - Radiology.

In this role, the successful candidate supports department-wide data collection, analysis, distribution, governance, and strategic data initiatives. This position reports to the Manager of Data Analytics; and is responsible for database, dashboard, analytic, and data reporting support as well as conducting projects affiliated with all missions. The role involves developing and managing databases, designing and managing data collection methods, statistical data analysis, creating reports, and data visualization to present to departmental leadership.

Job Responsibilities


Extracts data from the medical centers data warehouse via Azure Databricks
Creates/maintains complex SQL codes and stored procedures that feed and refresh the data models
Conducts analysis by compiling data, managing data bases, analyzing data and presenting results in numerical and graphic formats
Assists department leadership in conducting process analysis, problem identification and root cause analysis, organization and environmental analysis and formulating recommendations for improvement
Assists in coordinating and facilitating communication within the department to ensure consistent analytical approaches
Assists in sharing of knowledge, best practices, and analytical approaches
Plays an active role in providing data for operational improvements
Visualizes analytic insights and create dashboards with the use of Tableau for end stakeholders to use in decision-making and monitoring of performance.
Manages and improves existing databases; develops programs, methodologies, and files for analyzing and presenting data
Works with clinical, administrative and operational data, and be responsible for analyzing and presenting data; performing data analysis in support of ad-hoc and standing requests
Researches new data sources and analytical tools/methodologies; contributes to new product development and improvement in product delivery and presentation
Assists leadership in developing Department of Radiology
Provides subject matter expertise in the area of data analytics
Supports department adherence to NYU Langone Health data related policies & procedures
Serves as a liaison between the department and greater data science community both within NYU and at-large
Stays up to date with data science technologies and/or best practices
Performs additional duties as assigned


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Public Health, Computer or Systems Engineering or related field that further developed your expertise in the business of health and healthcare, required.
1-2+ years of experience in writing complex SQL, including complex joins, subqueries, and aggregation, required.
1+ years of data analytics experience using data visualization software such as Tableau Proven ability to create concise reports based upon specifications requested by management Excellent problem-solving skills, required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including advanced proficiency in Excel
Attention to detail, especially with regard to data visualization Strong oral, written and presentation communication skills.
Must be a professional football player


Preferred Qualifications


Masters in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Public Health, Computer or Systems Engineering or related field that further developed your expertise in the business of health and healthcare.


Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

The Analyst II, Data Analysis will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to derive actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role requires a skilled data analyst with strong analytical abilities, a deep understanding of statistical methods, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in data analysis, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for leveraging data to drive business outcomes.

What You’ll Do


Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Develop and implement statistical models and algorithms to solve business problems.
Validate and refine models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Create clear and compelling data visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare and present regular reports on data analysis outcomes to senior leadership.
Develop dashboards and other tools to enable self-service data access for business users.
Collect, clean, and preprocess data from various sources to ensure data quality and consistency.
Collaborate with data engineers and IT teams to design and implement data pipelines and workflows.
Ensure data is properly stored, organized, and accessible for analysis.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and finance, to support data-driven decision-making.
Provide training and support to team members on data analysis and visualization best practices.
Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analysis.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement innovative solutions.
Attends company training and regional training in area of expertise. Presents own work to members of department.


What You’ll Bring To Zelis


Typically has Bach. +2-3 yrs; Masters +0 yrs
Requires proficiency using AI tools skillfully with an understanding of how to develop/create intelligent prompts and/or agents.
Fluency with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Excel).
Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
Healthcare claims editing experience a plus.
Understanding of statistics and data modeling preferred.
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience presenting findings to senior leadership team
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) is a plus.
Knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Certification in data analysis or related fields.


Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Location and Workplace Flexibility

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.

While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

Base Salary Range

$71,000.00 - $90,250.00

At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job-related and industry-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role.

Zelis’ full-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all.

Accessibility Support

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com.

Description:
Saturn is a returns-driven Canadian energy company focused on the efficient, responsible and innovative development of high-quality, light oil weighted assets, supported by an acquisition strategy targeting accretive and complementary opportunities. The Company’s portfolio of free-cash flowing, low-decline operated assets in Saskatchewan and Alberta provide a deep inventory of long-term economic drilling opportunities across multiple zones. With an unwavering commitment to building an entrepreneurial focused culture, Saturn’s goal is to increase per share reserves, production and cash flow at an attractive return on invested capital. Position Summary For Sr Data Analyst

Responsible for defining, implementing and supporting advanced analytics solutions and capabilities. Provides expertise in the integration, analysis and wrangling of data in support of solving business problems. Manipulates and analyzes complex datasets with a variety of tools; communicates results clearly and concisely to provide insight to multiple audiences.

Position Summary For Principal Data Analyst

Responsible as team lead for defining, implementing and supporting advanced analytics solutions and capabilities. Determines work load and priority for the team. Provides expertise in the integration, analysis and wrangling of data in support of solving business problems. Manipulates/ analyzes complex datasets with a variety of tools; communicates results clearly and concisely to provide insight to multiple audiences.

Essential Responsibilities


Data Wrangling/Exploration: Follow consistent practices to ensure data integrity and deal with imperfections in data. Effectively process structured data; proficiently integrate data sets from various sources; confidently draw conclusions from data. Collaborate with business stakeholders as needed to ensure solid data understanding and proper data transformation; work cross-functionally with development and engineering teams. Analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns; draw conclusions and gain actionable insights from data.
Programming: Develop efficient and high quality code; follow solid validation process to ensure consistency and minimize errors; adhere to version control standards. Maintain skills through continuing education; seamlessly transition between languages to apply the right approach to the right problem.
Work Management - Manages multiple tasks, with the ability to deal with ambiguity and shifting priorities. Communicates status and estimates clearly and timely to management and team members.
Data Visualization: Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate results and highlight business impact. Utilize various visualization techniques and delivery methods of visualization that are audience appropriate (e.g. interactive, statistical, and exploratory).
Communication: Effectively communicate technical information to numerous audiences (e.g. senior management, client community, peers and junior associates); effectively develop relationships with individuals inside and outside of IT. Address challenges to analytic processes and influence others to change their approach and work collectively to implement new tools/techniques. Gain support from related stakeholders for analytic solutions.
Continuing Education - takes a proactive approach to understanding industry and organization-specific business issues. Participates in structured and self-study training courses. Continually improves technical skills and learns new data sources.

Bachelor's degree in MIS, CIS, Statistics, Analytics or related IT degree or sufficient experience
Minimum of 5 years of experience in an analytics environment
Expertise in SQL
Comfortable working with large, complex data sets - drawing conclusions and proposing recommendations
Proven ability to effectively partner, collaborate, and communicate with technical and non-technical colleagues in various business functions at all levels
Hands-on experience constructing visual analytics
Working knowledge of an analytics data warehouse and big data platform
Familiarity with fundamentals of statistics, probability and data pipelines
Strong attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to wrangle data
Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data

Bachelor's degree in MIS, CIS, Statistics, Analytics or related IT degree or equivalent experience
Minimum of 8 years' experience in an analytics environment
Expertise in SQL
Comfortable working with large, complex data sets - drawing conclusions and proposing recommendations
Proven ability to effectively partner, collaborate, and communicate with technical and non-technical colleagues in various business functions at all levels

Working knowledge of a big data platform
Familiarity with fundamentals of statistics and probability

Strong attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to wrangle data
Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data
Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to lead a team

Overview

As a subject matter expert, the Healthcare Data Analyst Senior leverages strong analytical and technical skills to provide data-driven recommendations, support regulatory reporting, and enable performance improvement across clinical and operational domains.

This role also mentors junior analysts and collaborates with internal teams and external partners to deliver impactful analytics solutions.

Education


Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field (Required)



Certification/Licensure


One or all of: Power BI Certification, Epic Certification, Databricks Certified (strongly Preferred)



Experience

Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar visualization tools required
Experience working with Databricks or similar data platforms (Preferred)
Experience in healthcare analytics, including clinical, operational, or regulatory reporting
Ability to perform ad-hoc analysis, define business requirements, and deliver actionable insights
Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate data into meaningful recommendations

Experience mentoring junior analysts and supporting analytics best practices

Description:
Our Mission

To create an organization that sets the standard of excellence in the compassionate treatment of behavioral health and addiction disorders.

Who are we?

Since 2015, Nevada Behavioral Health Systems (NBH) has been providing mental health and substance abuse services to residents across Nevada. By collaborating with a diverse network of experienced behavioral healthcare providers, we have built a community-based care system that offers members personalized options tailored to their individual needs. In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Las Vegas, NV – Onsite (This role is not eligible for Remote or Hybrid)

Starting Salary Range: $60,000 - $70,000

The starting salary range for this role is a reasonable estimate, with a goal to pay a competitive market salary focusing near the median of our pay ranges. However, final offers for all positions will be based on several factors such as experience level, education and certification, skills, and internal pay equity.

What’s the role?

The Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data to uncover actionable insights that drive clinical, operational, and business decisions. This role requires expertise in healthcare analytics, specifically in interpreting clinical and operational data requests, managing large claims datasets, and developing data visualizations that effectively tell a story to diverse stakeholders. Proficiency with healthcare frameworks such as HEDIS, NCQA, and value-based care metrics is critical to success in this role.

What you’ll do:


Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to translate requests into actionable queries and analytics that inform decisionmaking.
Analyze large datasets, including claims data, to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate insights related to cost, utilization, and quality.
Develop dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to present findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences, tailoring presentations to executive stakeholders when necessary.
Design and implement frameworks for tracking healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care measures.
Perform data cleaning and validation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of datasets.
Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.


What you’ll bring:


Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.


What you’ll need to start:


Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Health Informatics, Public Health or a related field Preferred.
3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.
Proven experience with claims data analysis, including familiarity with total cost of care and utilization metrics.
Certified Healthcare Data Analyst (CHDA) certification or similar credentials.
Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.


What will make you stand out:


Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.

Competitive Salary
Generous vacation policy, paid holidays, and paid sick time
Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance (Employeepaid)
Optional supplemental Insurance Coverage
Company paid access to Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
401k Retirement Savings Plan

Preferred Auto, Home and Renter’s insurance through Allstate
Employee Discounts through Corestream
…and so much more!

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by following governance standards and best practices
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work efficiently under pressure, accurately meet deadlines, present a professional demeanor and work well independently is essential

Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Highly proficient in Excel and comfortable with using formulas, vlookups and pivot table and graph
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is helpful but not required
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Master’s degree in a relevant field

Compensation

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Services
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Brief Description

About the Role:

The Junior Data Analyst will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do


Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.


Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:


Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Are proficient in Excel.
Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.


What's In It For You


Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.
A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
A scaling company with great industry professionals.
Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.


Work Location / Type:


This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.
Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas and ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Knowledge of the military and Intelligence Community
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Advanced SQL and Python skills.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com

On highways, construction sites, city streets, logging roads - everywhere our customers earn their living - Peterbilt's red oval is a familiar symbol of performance, reliability and pride. Peterbilt has reigned as America's premium quality truck manufacturer since the company's founding in 1939. Our dedication to deliver products and services focused on improving customers' performance, image, profitability and peace of mind truly makes Peterbilt the Class of the Industry.

Requisition Summary

Peterbilt has an immediate need for a talented and self-motivated Data Analyst. This position will support the AfterSales Department with reporting and in-depth data analysis. This role reports to the Data Analytics Manager, AfterSales.

Job Responsibilities


Extract, clean, merge, transform and compile data from various data sources, including relational databases, flat files, NoSQL databases and unstructured data using Python and SQL.
Create and implement dashboards and reports in Tableau to share metrics and insights with team members and senior executives.
Integrate AfterSales data from multiple sources to produce a single overarching view of the customer AfterSales experience.
Monthly General Manager Warranty Meetings Data Extraction and query updates.
Develop and implement analytical model that provide actionable insights to support cross functional team objectives.

Develop new process improvements to increase the speed, accuracy, and efficiency of our work.
Create and present materials on data projects.

Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field
7+ years of applicable job experience, with a proven ability to make process improvements
Experience in creating executive/summary level dashboards and reports, integrating many data sources
Experience with Snowflake and Python
Strong understanding of advanced Tableau features and capabilities


Preferred Qualifications


Must be a highly motivated self-starter and self-directed learner with a creative mind, high attention to detail and a solution-oriented outlook

401k with up to a 5% company match

Collaborer avec les équipes métiers e-commerce pour comprendre les besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Formation Bac+5 (data, informatique, ingénierie ou équivalent).

Expérience ou forte appétence pour les sujets IA (projets concrets appréciés).

Rigueur et sens du détail.

Autonomie et proactivité.
