Title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition 🇫🇷
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
Increased accountability in project leadership
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:


Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
Are Fluent in French & English


What does the recruitment process look like?


A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)


What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :


To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity


We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to dpo@pennylane.com. Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
  • Increased accountability in project leadership
  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
  • Are Fluent in French & English

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
  • A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
  • Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.


Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices


Profile


At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued


Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Description:
💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

5 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :




✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée : Dans des secteurs variés, avec une approche "sur mesure" où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️Une culture d’excellence technique : Avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️Une équipe passionnée et engagée : Des ingénieurs recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : Le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

✔️Des missions à impact, visibles et valorisantes : Où vous aurez un impact réel sur les décisions métiers et la valeur business générée.




📍 Localisation : Paris (75002) avec 2-3 jours de télétravail hebdomadaire

💶 Rémunération : A discuter selon vos prétentions

🗓️ Démarrage : ASAP

Title: Data Analyst II - Finance and Commercial
Description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Data Analyst

In this role, you will transform complex data into clear insights that guide commercial decision-making. You will contribute to the development of scalable analytics solutions, from dashboards to data pipelines, while collaborating closely with senior data analysts, data engineers, and cross-functional partners across the business.

What you’ll do


Support technical contributions- Assist in the development and optimization of Revenue Operations data pipelines using SQL, Python, and big-data tools. Contribute to ETL improvements to ensure data consistency and reliability.
Reporting and dashboards- Build and maintain LookML models and Looker dashboards to deliver accurate, timely insights to commercial stakeholders
Data quality and governance- Play an active role in data governance initiatives by cleaning, transforming, and documenting datasets, ensuring accuracy and reliability.
Automation- Contribute to the automation of recurring reporting processes (e.g., Quarterly Business Reviews, pipeline reporting)


Scalability- Develop scalable, reliable, and sustainable data products that can be re-purposed for different use cases.Collaboration- Work closely with cross-functional data teams and other Revenue Operations functions to align on data initiatives and technical improvements.


Developing insights- Analyze datasets and translate findings into actionable insights for the commercial teams.


Who you are

Must Haves


2-4 years of experience in Data Analytics with proven expertise in the field.
Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and processing.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within a global, multicultural team.
Data Wrangling expertise- skilled in cleaning, transforming, and organizing large datasets, handling missing data, detecting outliers, and ensuring data integrity.
Good analytical skills- adept at extracting meaningful insights from complex datasets and translating them into actionable recommendations.
Flexibility for occasional business travel to support global collaboration and projects


Plus


Familiarity with analytical and statistical techniques (e.g., distributions, correlations, hypothesis testing, regression analysis) and with validation frameworks.
Exposure to big-data tools such as PySpark, Airflow or Git.
A background in econometrics, data science, engineering, or other quantitative studies


Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Banque mutualiste et régionale, La Caisse d'Epargne CEPAC est aujourd’hui l’une des premières banques de l’arc méditerranéen et de l’outre-mer.

Au sein du Département Data, vos principales missions seront de :


Participer à l’identification et à la qualification des besoins en relation avec différents acteurs internes et externes
Réaliser des études orientées client et proposer des plans d’action en lien avec la stratégie commerciale de la CEPAC
Contrôler, analyser et challenger la fiabilité des données de la CEPAC dans une logique d’amélioration de la connaissance client et d’optimisation de nos processus de fonctionnement
Développer, maintenir et optimiser les différents outils de datavisualisation proposés par le département à ses interlocuteurs internes et externes

Compétences techniques:


Maîtrise du langage SQL
Connaissance d’un outil de datavisualisation de type Power BI


Qualités requises :


Capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de restitution à des profils techniques et non-techniques
Aisance relationnelle et esprit d’équipe
Force de proposition
Capacité à mener plusieurs projets de front


Formation :


Formation supérieure type école d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé dans l’analyse de données (informatique, statistiques)
Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans sur un poste similaire (analyse de données, études clients et mise en œuvre de plans d'actions)


Expérience requise :


Une première expérience dans le milieu bancaire est un plus

Possibilité de travail selon les accords d'entreprise (2 jours par semaine après 6 mois d'ancienneté)

Mutuelle d’entreprise du Groupe BPCE (prise en charge à 52%)
Retraite supplémentaire et Prévoyance

Avantages bancaires (Cotisation de carte bancaire offerte/Compte courant rémunéré/Taux préférentiels)

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé (H/F)

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !

Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer

Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature

Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


Profil recherché

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 3 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.

Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
As an F&B Data Analyst, you are at the center of complex challenges within the food and beverage industry. You translate large volumes of raw data, such as sales figures, inventory movements, consumer trends and production data, into clear strategic insights and concrete action points for our clients and internal teams.

Our company is based out of Vianen, Utrecht (NL). We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who we are:

At Real Result, we are the independent purchasing experts for the dynamic foodservice industry. We help our clients maximize their procurement, whether it's through volume discounts, purchasing optimization, real-time cost price insights, or the realization of commercial kitchens and bars. We are looking for talent that helps our clients achieve their ambitions. Since 2025, Real Result has been part of Buyers Edge Platform, a digital procurement network/software platform for the foodservice industry that connects operators, distributors, and manufacturers. The platform offers group purchasing services, SaaS-based technology solutions, and supply chain consulting and procurement-related services to foodservice parties with the aim of reducing costs and improving supply chain decisions through data-driven technology. As a Buyer at Real Result, you are the linchpin in strategic purchasing processes. You work closely with various leading players in the sector, from hospitality to catering and from Leisure to on-the-move. Our client base is diverse and impressive. Think of names like Ron Blaauw, Perfect Serve, Albron, Beerze Bulten, Vue Cinemas, Koninklijk Theater Carré, and many others.

Your impact:


Data Analysis & Reporting: Develop, maintain and automate dashboards, KPI reports and analyses tailored to the food and beverage market.
Trend & Market Analysis: Identify consumption trends, seasonal effects and cost fluctuations within the F&B sector.
Advisory: Proactively advise clients and management based on data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
Data Quality Management: Safeguard the quality, integrity and reliability of supplied and processed data sources.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to implement client-specific data solutions.
Accuracy and timeliness of delivered dashboards and analyses.
Measurable cost savings or efficiency gains realized for clients based on your recommendations.
Successful adoption and use of data tools by end users.


About you:


Education: Vocational (MBO) or bachelor's (HBO) degree in (Business) Mathematics, Data Science, Econometrics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant work experience as a data analyst or in a similar role, preferably within the Food & Beverage, FMCG or retail sector.
Technical skills:
Excellent command of SQL and Excel.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Competencies: Strong analytical skills, results-oriented, communicative (able to translate complex data into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders) and commercially aware.


What We Offer:


A market-based salary aligned with your knowledge and experience, plus an attractive benefits package, including 25 vacation days, holiday allowance and flexible working hours.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Company car or mobility allowance
Excellent benefits and development opportunities.
Room for initiative and personal growth within an innovative and ambitious organization.
An inspiring work environment with passionate colleagues from the industry.

Title: Data Analist
Description:
Bij Essent gebruiken we data om betere keuzes te maken voor onze klanten en onze organisatie. Als Data Analist binnen het team D&A Sales speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je onderzoekt data, signaleert kansen voor verbetering en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen. Zo help je teams om klantreizen te verbeteren, commerciële doelen te realiseren en processen slimmer in te richten.


Je werkt hypothese gedreven: je start vanuit een vraagstuk, onderzoekt beschikbare data en past de juiste analysemethoden toe om antwoorden te vinden. Vervolgens presenteer je jouw inzichten op een manier die begrijpelijk en bruikbaar is voor verschillende stakeholders. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit business, data en technologie. Zo draag je dagelijks bij aan datagedreven besluitvorming en aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Essent als moderne energiepartner.

Alleen samen zetten we de volgende stap in de energietransitie. Jij bent als Data Analist dé expert binnen jouw vakgebied bij het:




Ontwikkelen van analyses, dashboards en visualisaties die bijdragen aan betere commerciële beslissingen


Onderzoeken van bestaande en nieuwe databronnen om kansen en verbeteringen zichtbaar te maken


Beheren, optimaliseren en vernieuwen van dataoplossingen zodat deze aansluiten bij gebruikersbehoeften en het datalandschap van Essent.


Kennis van data engineering om zelfstandig verbeteringen door te voeren, de kwaliteit van data te waarborgen en effectief samen te werken met Data Engineers. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt je kennis binnen de data community en past je kennis toe bij het verbeteren van data oplossingen en manieren van werken


Vertalen van complexe analyses naar heldere inzichten, conclusies en adviezen voor stakeholders


Signaleren, prioriteren en uitwerken van vraagstukken met de grootste impact op klant- en organisatiedoelen


Ondersteunen en coachen van collega’s door kennis te delen, werkzaamheden te reviewen en verbeterkansen aan te dragen




Sanne Steegstra, Data Manager Sales: ‘In deze functie ben je onderdeel van de afdeling Data & AI en werk je binnen het team D&A Sales. Het team bestaat uit Data Analisten, Data Engineers, Data Scientists en andere dataspecialisten. Samen gaan wij voor het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare dataoplossingen en inzichten die bijdragen aan betere commerciële beslissingen en een optimale klantreis. We combineren domeinkennis met data-expertise, delen actief kennis met elkaar en werken samen aan oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en de organisatie.

Voor deze functie neem je het volgende mee:




Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau met een opleiding waarin data, statistiek of analyse een belangrijke rol speelt


Ervaring met het uitvoeren van data-analyses en het ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages


Gevorderde vaardigheden in SQL en Python


Ervaring met datavisualisatietools zoals Tableau of Power BI


Kennis van data modellering, master data management en data governance




De ideale kandidaat voor deze functie heeft bovengemiddeld talent voor analytisch denken, samenwerken, klantgericht verbeteren en het vertalen van inzichten naar acties.

We waarderen de energie en motivatie die jij in je werk stopt zodat wij energiepartner van onze klanten kunnen zijn. Dat doen we met een mooi pakket aan voorwaarden. Wij bieden je:




De kans om vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen aan de energietransitie in Nederland


Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.067 en € 7.195


Een flexibel benefit budget dat je maandelijks naar wens opspaart, laat uitbetalen of inzet voor verlof. Dit budget is opgebouwd uit de waarde van: 8% vakantiegeld, 1,8% benefit bijdrage, 10 bovenwettelijke vrije dagen


Een jaarlijkse resultaatafhankelijke uitkering van 10% om onze waardering nog meer uit te spreken


De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, maar dan ook echt. Jij bepaalt waar je werkt, iedere dag weer. Liever een workation? 20 dagen per jaar mag je vanuit een ander land binnen Europa werken


Korting op je energierekening én op alle energieproducten (zonnepanelen, warmtepomp, onderhoud etc.)


Een prachtig hoofdkantoor op loopafstand van Centraal Station Den Bosch met o.a. een goede koffiebar, bedrijfsrestaurant en gratis vers fruit


Een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer of een kilometervergoeding. Jij bepaalt


Opleidingen, trainingen en cursussen volg je op onze kosten. Internationale ambitie? Als onderdeel van de E.ON Group bieden we je ook volop ontwikkelkansen binnen de andere E.ON-landen


En last but not least: een omgeving waarin je jezelf kunt zijn. Voor ons telt alleen wie je bent en wat je kunt. Voel je vrij om je sekse, nationaliteit en leeftijd weg te laten op je cv.




Dit is dé kans om als Data Analist aan de slag te gaan. Solliciteer voor 4 oktober om Essenter te worden. Benieuwd naar het vervolg? Bekijk de stappen van onze sollicitatieprocedure hieronder.

Als energieleverancier helpen we ruim 2,5 miljoen klanten in de particuliere en zakelijke markt. Met onze merken Essent, Energiedirect, Vandebron en onze servicepartners door heel Nederland helpen we onze klanten met de volgende stap in de energietransitie. Met duurzamer leven én energie besparen. Dat doen we met producten zoals zonnepanelen, warmtepompen en isolatie voor een energiezuinige woning. Daarnaast investeren we volop in innovatieve oplossingen die onderdeel uitmaken van het energiesysteem van de toekomst, zoals waterstof en koude- en warmteoplossingen. Essent is onderdeel van de E.ON Group.

Samen gaan wij voor het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare dataoplossingen en inzichten die bijdragen aan betere commerciële beslissingen en een optimale klantreis. We combineren domeinkennis met data-expertise, delen actief kennis met elkaar en werken samen aan oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en de organisatie.

Voor deze functie neem je het volgende mee:


  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau met een opleiding waarin data, statistiek of analyse een belangrijke rol speelt

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van data-analyses en het ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages

  • Gevorderde vaardigheden in SQL en Python

  • Ervaring met datavisualisatietools zoals Tableau of Power BI

  • Kennis van data modellering, master data management en data governance



De ideale kandidaat voor deze functie heeft bovengemiddeld talent voor analytisch denken, samenwerken, klantgericht verbeteren en het vertalen van inzichten naar acties.

We waarderen de energie en motivatie die jij in je werk stopt zodat wij energiepartner van onze klanten kunnen zijn. Dat doen we met een mooi pakket aan voorwaarden. Wij bieden je:


  • De kans om vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen aan de energietransitie in Nederland

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.067 en € 7.195

  • Een flexibel benefit budget dat je maandelijks naar wens opspaart, laat uitbetalen of inzet voor verlof. Dit budget is opgebouwd uit de waarde van: 8% vakantiegeld, 1,8% benefit bijdrage, 10 bovenwettelijke vrije dagen

  • De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, maar dan ook echt. Jij bepaalt waar je werkt, iedere dag weer. Liever een workation? 20 dagen per jaar mag je vanuit een ander land binnen Europa werken

  • Korting op je energierekening én op alle energieproducten (zonnepanelen, warmtepomp, onderhoud etc.)

  • Een prachtig hoofdkantoor op loopafstand van Centraal Station Den Bosch met o.a. een goede koffiebar, bedrijfsrestaurant en gratis vers fruit

  • Een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer of een kilometervergoeding. Jij bepaalt

  • Opleidingen, trainingen en cursussen volg je op onze kosten. Internationale ambitie? Als onderdeel van de E.ON Group bieden we je ook volop ontwikkelkansen binnen de andere E.ON-landen

  • En last but not least: een omgeving waarin je jezelf kunt zijn. Voor ons telt alleen wie je bent en wat je kunt. Voel je vrij om je sekse, nationaliteit en leeftijd weg te laten op je cv.



Dit is dé kans om als Data Analist aan de slag te gaan. Solliciteer voor 4 oktober om Essenter te worden. Benieuwd naar het vervolg? Bekijk de stappen van onze sollicitatieprocedure hieronder.

Als energieleverancier helpen we ruim 2,5 miljoen klanten in de particuliere en zakelijke markt. Met onze merken Essent, Energiedirect, Vandebron en onze servicepartners door heel Nederland helpen we onze klanten met de volgende stap in de energietransitie. Met duurzamer leven én energie besparen. Dat doen we met producten zoals zonnepanelen, warmtepompen en isolatie voor een energiezuinige woning. Daarnaast investeren we volop in innovatieve oplossingen die onderdeel uitmaken van het energiesysteem van de toekomst, zoals waterstof en koude- en warmteoplossingen. Essent is onderdeel van de E.ON Group.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Job Summary

ProMach is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst to help transform our complex data landscape into actionable business insights. You’ll work with data from multiple ERP, CRM, and operational systems, supporting key business decisions in finance, operations, and supply chain. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on data work, cross-functional collaboration, and building impactful reports and dashboards. Fluency in Italian and English required

Why This Role Matters

As a Data Analyst at ProMach, you’ll play a critical role in shaping business strategy by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data from dozens of systems and databases. Your insights will help drive efficiency, identify opportunities, and support growth across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other business systems to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reports for business users and leadership.
Write SQL queries and use analytics tools to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements.
Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and presentations.
Support data migration, integration, and quality initiatives to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Document data processes, definitions, and methodologies for transparency and repeatability.
Stay current with best practices in data analysis, visualization, and reporting.


Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or analytical area, or demonstrated equivalent experience in data analysis or a related field
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data kccuracy.
Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional teams.
Deep Knowledge of data flows within ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Infor LN, Salesforce) in a manufacturing environment
Candidate must be fluent in both Italian and English.


Preferred


Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake).
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata documentation.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
Exposure to Agile project environments and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git).

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties.   • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;

  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics.

The Analytics pillar is itself organised into three teams, supporting different parts of the organisation and working closely with Product and Business teams.

You will join the team led by Ludivine, our Data Analytics Manager, and work on a wide range of topics, including product usage and adoption, performance steering, and understanding our customers and their activities.

You will work directly with Product and Business teams across several European markets, turning their challenges into analyses, metrics and decision-making tools that enable better decisions.

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What's in it for you?


Direct impact on decision-making: your work will directly influence how Product and Business teams make decisions around adoption, performance and growth across different markets, with strong visibility among senior leadership.
True end-to-end ownership: you will own your topics from understanding and framing the initial need through analysis, solution development and presentation of the results.
A cross-functional business scope: you will work on a variety of challenges across ERP, Payroll and Commerce, spanning several European markets.
Direct stakeholder collaboration: you will work directly with Product and Business teams as well as local leaders to understand their challenges and build the right analytical solutions together.
An environment to build and shape: you will contribute to structuring the KPIs, definitions, data models and decision-making tools required across the different business areas.
A modern Analytics stack: you will work primarily with SQL, dbt and Omni, partnering with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams on data platform and infrastructure topics.
An international environment: you will collaborate with teams across several European countries.
A hybrid work policy: enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business Understanding & Problem Framing: work directly with stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify their needs and translate them into relevant analytical questions.
End-to-End Analytics Ownership: own Analytics projects from the initial need through to the presentation of results, including framing, identifying the required data and stakeholders, conducting the analysis, building the deliverable and presenting your conclusions.
Analysis & Recommendations: explore and analyse data to identify trends, understand behaviours and usage patterns, investigate discrepancies or unexpected results, and turn analyses into actionable conclusions for Product and Business teams.
KPI Definition & Governance: help define, document and maintain reliable, consistent and shared business KPIs and definitions.
Dashboards & Decision-Making Tools: design and deliver actionable dashboards in Omni, enabling Product and Business teams to monitor their KPIs, understand their activities and steer performance.
Data Modelling: build robust and scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad hoc analysis and reporting needs.
Stakeholder Management: manage relationships directly with Product and Business teams, challenge requests when necessary, and communicate clearly about progress, findings, risks and blockers.
Data Collaboration: work closely with other Analysts as well as Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams, share knowledge and contribute to building common Analytics practices.


📍 Job located in Paris or Berlin with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You


Experience: you have solid experience in Data Analytics and have already owned analytical topics independently. Demonstrated autonomy and ownership matter more than an exact number of years of experience.
Technical Excellence: you have excellent SQL skills and solid experience with dbt, including modelling, testing and documentation.
Business Intelligence: you have strong experience with BI and Data Visualisation tools. Hands-on experience with Omni will be particularly valued.
Analytical & Critical Thinking: you know how to structure a problem, challenge data and definitions, investigate unexpected results and draw relevant conclusions.
Business Understanding: you can quickly understand a new business domain, ask the right questions and translate business challenges into analytical approaches.
Ownership & Autonomy: you are able to take ownership of a topic end-to-end and move it forward independently, while knowing when to involve the right people.
Stakeholder Management: you are comfortable working directly with Product and Business stakeholders, understanding their expectations and constructively challenging their requests.
Communication: you can synthesise complex analyses and clearly communicate your conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaboration: you enjoy working as part of a team, sharing knowledge and contributing to collective success.
Data Stack: familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. More advanced data platform and infrastructure topics are supported by our Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams.
Languages: fluent French and the ability to work professionally in English in an international environment.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Manager Interview (60’): Discussion with Ludivine (Hiring Manager)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.

Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst

Every IT decision worth making starts with the right data behind it, someone who can turn raw numbers from systems, applications and infrastructure into insights that actually change how the business operates.




At Darwind, we don't fit consultants into projects, we look for the project that fits you. You'll join a community of Darwinders who value autonomy, ownership, and genuine professional growth, and who believe the best work experience should always be the next one.




What you will do

As Data Analyst, you'll turn data from IT systems and business applications into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across the organisation. Concretely, you will:

Collect, clean and structure data from IT systems, applications and databases
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik
Analyse IT service usage, system performance and cost data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
Write and optimise SQL queries to extract and combine data from multiple sources
Translate business questions into data driven answers for IT and business stakeholders
Support the development of ETL processes and data pipelines together with data engineering colleagues
Validate data quality and flag inconsistencies before they reach decision makers
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, actionable way to both technical and non technical audiences
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting standards and data governance practices

Who you are

We look beyond the CV. For us, motivation and curiosity matter just as much as the technical box-ticking, but to thrive in this role, you'll likely recognise yourself in most of the following:

You hold a master's degree in data science, IT, statistics, business engineering or a related field
You have at least 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst in an IT environment
You are proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large, complex data sets
You have hands on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik
Knowledge of Python or R is a plus
You have an eye for detail and a structured, analytical mindset
You can explain technical findings in a way that makes sense to non technical stakeholders
You are fluent in Dutch, French is a plus




What we offer

Competitive benefits package

Hospitalization insurance
Group insurance
Meal allowance
Your choice between a company car with EU fuel card or the federal mobility budget

Learning and growth

Continuous coaching
Technical and soft-skills training
Room to grow across different domains and technologies

Culture

A human, transparent and collaborative environment
Real ownership and influence on the projects you contribute to
A team that lives its values, initiative, authenticity and open communication, every day

Ready for your next step?

If the traditional consultancy model never quite resonated with you, and you're looking for a place where people, impact and growth genuinely matter, let's talk.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.
