Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Our Commitment

At Ogury, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace by providing equal employment opportunities to all. We will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Please note that this position is for an existing vacancy and is open to all qualified candidates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
All’interno del team Chief Strategy, Business Development and Wholebuy Office – Competence Development Center, ricerchiamo una persona da inserire nel ruolo di Business Data Analyst motivata e con un forte approccio analitico, da inserire presso la nostra sede di Roma.

Attività previste dal ruolo:

La persona individuata si occuperà di analizzare e interpretare dati provenienti da diverse fonti aziendali, sviluppando soluzioni di analisi e monitoraggio a supporto delle decisioni di business e contribuendo all’automazione e all’industrializzazione dei processi di elaborazione dei dati.

In particolare, la risorsa sarà coinvolta in:


Definizione degli scope progettuali e traduzione delle esigenze di business in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Analisi di fenomeni complessi attraverso dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee.
Individuazione di KPI e metriche rilevanti per il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.
Sviluppo e automazione di processi di elaborazione, controllo e analisi dei dati.
Verifica della qualità, della coerenza e dell’affidabilità delle informazioni prima della loro condivisione con gli stakeholder.
Individuazione di anomalie nei dati e supporto alle attività di troubleshooting e riconciliazione tra fonti differenti.
Interpretazione dei risultati delle analisi, distinguendo evidenze, ipotesi e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Sviluppo autonomo di analisi, KPI e strumenti di supporto alle decisioni.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace degli insight e dei risultati analitici, anche a interlocutori non tecnici.
Gestione autonoma delle attività assegnate, in collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Tali attività saranno svolte con riferimento al processo di integrazione delle competenze funzionali al percorso di trasformazione aziendale in atto.

Requisiti richiesti:


Laurea o percorso specialistico in discipline quantitative o tecnico-scientifiche, quali Data Science, Statistica, Matematica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia quantitativa o percorsi affini.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL e capacità di lavorare con dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni.
Buona conoscenza di Python, con particolare riferimento all’analisi e alla trasformazione dei dati.
Conoscenza delle principali librerie Python per la data analysis, quali Pandas, NumPy o equivalenti.
Capacità di sviluppare processi di data preparation, aggregazione, riconciliazione e controllo qualità.
Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione del dato e delle problematiche relative a granularità, duplicazioni, join e consistenza tra fonti.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di database relazionali e/o data warehouse.
Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con strumenti quali BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Vertex AI, o con piattaforme cloud equivalenti.
Familiarità con strumenti di data visualization e dashboarding.
Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice, in particolare Git.
Conoscenza dei principi di sviluppo software, con attenzione alla leggibilità, alla modularità e alla manutenibilità del codice.
Familiarità con processi di automazione, scheduling e industrializzazione delle elaborazioni dati.
Familiarità con tecniche di prompt engineering e con strumenti low-code/no-code per la realizzazione di agenti AI e workflow basati su modelli generativi.


Competenze trasversali:


Forte capacità analitica e attitudine all’interpretazione di fenomeni complessi.
Orientamento alla qualità, all’affidabilità e alla coerenza del dato.
Capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli stakeholder e tradurle in requisiti analitici e tecnici.
Autonomia nella gestione delle attività e orientamento al risultato.
Problem solving e capacità di individuare anomalie e possibili cause dei fenomeni osservati.
Comunicazione chiara ed efficace, anche verso interlocutori non tecnici.
Predisposizione alla collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder di business.


Titoli preferenziali:


Esperienza nello sviluppo di analisi dati a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Esperienza nella costruzione e nel monitoraggio di KPI e metriche di performance.
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL in contesti progettuali o aziendali.
Esperienza nella gestione di dataset provenienti da fonti eterogenee e nelle attività di data quality e data reconciliation.
Esperienza nella realizzazione o manutenzione di dashboard e strumenti di reporting.
Familiarità con ambienti cloud, pipeline dati e processi CI/CD.


Cosa offriamo:


Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
RAL di partenza pari a 31.400€, stabilita utilizzando criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere. L’offerta economica effettiva potrà ulteriormente incrementarsi, entro parametri prestabiliti, in considerazione dell’evidenza di alcuni criteri di riferimento, quali il percorso formativo effettuato, l’esperienza professionale maturata nel ruolo e complessivamente, le certificazioni conseguite e la particolare affinità dimostrata rispetto al profilo ricercato.
Pacchetto welfare e benefit aggiuntivi.
Formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione.
Possibilità di lavorare su progetti di analisi, automazione e industrializzazione dei dati, utilizzando tecnologie cloud, strumenti di data visualization e soluzioni basate sull’intelligenza artificiale.
Opportunità di crescita in un contesto dinamico, innovativo e orientato alla trasformazione digitale.

Title: Cloud Data Analyst
Description:
Job Purpose

The Cloud Data Analyst is responsible for understanding business requirements and building suitable data models to deliver clear, meaningful reports and dashboards based to meet those requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across the business to turn data from the transactional databases of multiple systems and technologies into well-structured data models and high-quality Power BI reports that drive insight and decision-making.

This job provides a service to colleagues for the transformation of transactional data into business information

Key Responsibilities


Work closely with business colleagues across multiple departments to understand reporting needs
Translate business questions into clear data and reporting requirements
Challenge and refine requirements to ensure meaningful and actionable outputs and identify similar needs that can be aggregated into single solutions
Design and build efficient data models to support reporting and analysis
Combine and shape data from multiple sources (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, MySQL, APIs, other)
Use built-in connectors and query tools to extract and transform data
Handle both structured and semi-structured data sources
Ensure efficient, performant and secure handling of all reporting data through this process
Ensure data is presented as accurate, consistent and fit for purpose information to end users
Develop clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards using Power BI Desktop and publish in Power BI Service
Continuously improve reports based on user feedback
Utilizes AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, document automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards.



Base salary range: For this role, based in Bulgaria, the base salary range is €12000-35000 per year, set using objective, gender-neutral job evaluation criteria applied to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.

Determining your actual pay: Your base salary within this range will be based on objective, gender-neutral factors — work location, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary or negotiating position, nor will it fall below the range or below what colleagues in equal work receive.

Scope: This range covers base salary only, not bonuses, benefits, or other remuneration (as applicable).

Your rights: Tungsten Automation does not ask about current or past pay, and you need not disclose it. This notice does not limit your right to negotiate or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Experience

Skills & Experience


Ability to gather, interpret, and refine business requirements
Experience delivering reports and dashboards using Power BI and Fabric that drive business insight
Ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service
Proficient in data modelling, DAX and Power Query (M)
Good working knowledge of SQL and API fundamentals
Familiarity with data extraction and transformation techniques
Experience working in SaaS environments within Azure, AWS or similar
Awareness of data governance and security practices
Comfortable using AI-powered tools for tasks such as drafting content, summarizing information, data entry support, and workflow automation.
Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop, and scale to the needs of their department



General competencies


Proven ability to exploit AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI to speed development, drive automation and other efficiency gains
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving
Ability to turn requirements into structured solutions
Focus on delivering information-based insights to the business, not just tabular data
Attention to detail and data quality
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively when listening to requirements or explaining solutions

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
1. Propósito del Puesto (Misión)

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.




4. Requisitos del Perfil

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.




5. Qué Ofrecemos

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.
Seguro médico privado con cuadro médico o reembolso (50% cubierto para el empleado).
Plan de retribución flexible: vales de comida (tickets restaurante), transporte y guardería.
Horario flexible (entrada de 8:00 a 10:00, salida de 17:00 a 19:00) y viernes de jornada intensiva.

En Netquest, nos enorgullece ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y tenemos el compromiso de crear un entorno inclusivo para todos nuestros empleados, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, raza, religión, orientación sexual o discapacidad.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to help the organization leverage its data assets effectively.
  • Partner with various business units to define and prioritize reporting and data needs.
  • Provide reporting solutions and BI tools to support decision-making for both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain accurate, user-friendly dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
  • Manipulate data for ad-hoc queries and reporting using Python and advanced SQL.
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns within large and complex datasets (millions of records).
  • Monitor data sources and collaborate with Data Engineers to resolve discrepancies and uphold Data Quality standards.
  • Work collaboratively with the broader Data team (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and fellow Data Analysts).


3. Key Interfaces

  • Internal: Data team (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) and key business department stakeholders.
  • External: External clients or partners receiving analytical tools and ad-hoc reporting.


4. Requirements & Profile

  • Education & Experience:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in a Data Analyst role.
  • Technical Skills & Languages:
  • Proficiency in Python (including libraries such as pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
  • Strong SQL knowledge and query optimization.
  • Experience with BI tools (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
  • Languages: Fluent in English with clear communication skills.
  • Desirable: Cloud experience (especially AWS) and data management tools like dbt.
  • Behavioral Skills:
  • Excellent analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong storytelling skills to effectively present insights.
  • Team player with high attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.


5. What We Offer

  • Workplace Model: Hybrid model (2 days in the office, 3 days working from home)
  • Benefits:
  • Permanent contract.
  • Private health insurance with medical network or reimbursement (50% covered by the company).
  • Flexible compensation plan: meal vouchers, transportation, childcare.
  • Flexible working hours (start between 8:00–10:00 AM, finish between 5:00–7:00 PM) and intensive workdays on Fridays.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Data Analyst, Administration & Finance
Description:
Pay Range

The UMass President’s Office expects to pay within an approximate hiring range between $60,000 - $75,000 for this position. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment.

Primary Work Location:

Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query), Python, or R.
Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and reporting best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.



Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


Master’s degree in a related field



Working Conditions


Hybrid work environment. Primarily located at the UMass President’s Office located at 50 Washington St., Westborough, MA with remote work.
Must be able to travel occasionally to all UMass campuses and the Boston central office.



Additional Details

All offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Gas Engineering)
Description:
About Us

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.

At National Grid, we aim to create an environment where everyone is welcomed for who they are and where our differences are celebrated. We utilize the insights of our employees that come from all different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs to better serve our customers and communities.

National Grid is hiring a Senior Data Analyst (Gas Engineering). This hybrid role is located in our Waltham MA location.

Job Purpose

Responsible for advancing data management maturity, analytics capabilities, GIS utilization, and technology enablement across Gas Asset Management & Engineering (GAME). The role leads and supports efforts to improve asset data quality, governance, system connectivity, risk model utilization, automation, and reporting while advancing the strategic use of Snowflake, GIS, Enterprise Maximo, and related platforms.

The primary focus is to connect people, processes, data, and technology to create trusted, analytics-ready information that supports risk-informed asset management, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and measurable business value.

Key Accountabilities


Drive improved utilization of connected data across Snowflake, GIS, Enterprise Maximo, risk model platforms, reporting environments, and other relevant systems.
Define business and analytical requirements for data integration, interoperability, pipelines, interfaces, and reusable data models.
Identify data silos, reconciliation points, and manual handoffs; partner with IT and data engineering teams to implement sustainable improvements.
Promote end-to-end traceability from source data through analytical outputs and business decisions.
Expand the use of GIS from mapping and visualization to spatial analysis, workflow enablement, asset intelligence, and decision support.
Develop geospatial analytics supporting asset management, risk models, leak management, integrity activities, regulatory needs, and capital planning.
Improve GIS data quality, attribution, connectivity, topology, location accuracy, and usability in partnership with data owners and GIS teams.
Design reusable GIS-enabled tools, maps, dashboards, analyses, and automation that improve engineering and operational workflows.
Identify processes where coding, automation, integration, low-code tools, or emerging technology can remove non-value-added work and improve control effectiveness.
Design, code, test, document, deploy, and maintain reusable scripts, applications, workflows, and analytical tools using approved technologies.
Automate data extraction, transformation, validation, quality checks, GIS analysis, reporting, and repeatable business processes.
Develop proofs of concept and pilots; define value, controls, support needs, and transition paths for scalable solutions.
Apply sound development practices including modular design, version control, testing, documentation, monitoring, and knowledge transfer.
Develop advanced analysis, dashboards, KPIs, and executive scorecards that support asset, risk, investment, compliance, and operational decisions.
Perform data profiling, root-cause analysis, trend analysis, and scenario analysis to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Create repeatable analytical processes and self-service capabilities that improve consistency, speed, and transparency.
Translate complex data into clear findings, recommendations, and decision-ready stories.
Engage stakeholders to define business outcomes, requirements, priorities, success measures, and sustainment needs.
Communicate analytical findings, data risks, solution options, and technology opportunities to technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop business cases, roadmaps, recommendations, and implementation plans for leadership consideration.
Act as a trusted advisor connecting the business, data, GIS, and technology communities.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, GIS, or a related field
Minimum of 3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, engineering analytics, GIS, automation, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience delivering analytics, reporting, coded solutions, automation, or technology-enabled business improvements
Experience working with enterprise data platforms, complex datasets, and cross-functional stakeholders
Experience leading workstreams, projects, requirements development, or continuous improvement initiatives


Knowledge, Experience & Technical Know How


SQL; Power BI; Snowflake; advanced Excel; data modeling; data governance; data quality management
Python; scripting; APIs and web services; Git/version control; Power Apps; Power Automate
ArcGIS Pro; ArcGIS Enterprise; ArcPy; spatial analytics; Enterprise Maximo; utility asset data
ETL/ELT concepts; data pipelines; system interoperability; Azure data services
AI and generative AI applications; machine learning fundamentals; intelligent document extraction; risk analytics platforms such as Synergi or equivalent


Salary

$111,000 - $130,000 a year

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

National Grid utilizes an assessment that evaluates the job qualifications/characteristics using AI or statistically based scoring. For more information, please view NYC Local Law 144.

This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Candidates will be assessed and provided offers against the minimum qualifications of this role and their individual experience.

National Grid is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of protected class. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. National Grid maintains affirmative action programs for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Our employment practices are designed to ensure that all individuals are treated fairly and with respect throughout the hiring process and during employment. National Grid complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and we encourage a culture of respect for all.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!



Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.



Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.







Job Description



The Opportunity



We, at Flywire, are looking for a smart, analytical thinker who's excited to wow our clients with best in class data and analytics capabilities. As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will help set the vision and direction for how we communicate the story of Flywire's data to our clients, both with interactive in-app reporting solutions and custom analytics projects that speak to the unique value and ROI that our product has delivered throughout our partnership.



This is a true cross-functional role, with responsibilities crossing data & analytics, product development, relationship management, and sales. The ideal candidate will feel comfortable managing cross-functional projects and also have a deep technical understanding of a general BI stack and will be able to periodically contribute to development and analysis.



The responsibilities of the role include:



Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients
Partner with business stakeholders to understand unique client situations and deliver analyses to show the value of Flywire's value and performance
Lead the design and development of customer-facing dashboards
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure that reporting and analytical solutions are secure, scalable, and part of a seamless user experience


Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend
Emerging data science and analytical skills
Familiar and comfortable with emerging AI technologies, digital assistants for natural language queries, and core LLM tools
Strong business acumen by connecting data and dashboard design decisions to revenue, client retention, and broader company strategy, not just technical execution
Experience working with finance-related data (revenue, billing, payments, or similar financial reporting) and translating it into stakeholder-ready insights
Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns


Additional Information



Submit today and get started!



We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.



Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.



The US base salary range for this full-time position is $91,000 - $114,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training.

Title: Senior GTM Data Analyst
Description:
About the company: LinkSquares is a Boston-based, AI-powered CLM SaaS leader trusted by organizations like DraftKings, Manscaped, and Vivid Seats. We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.

About the team: Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.

About the role: As the Senior GTM Data Analyst, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?

You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.

Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.
AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Compensation for this role includes an annual base salary range between $150,000 to $175,000. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus. LinkSquares takes into consideration a number of factors when determining an employee’s starting salary, including work location, job-related skills, and relevant education, experience and training. The recruiter assigned to this role will share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates are eligible to participate in the company’s benefit programs. LinkSquares’ benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan with a company match, equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), flexible paid time off, generous parental leave, life and disability insurances and more.

LinkSquares is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any legally protected characteristics.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop as an Analytics Engineer, Report Developer, and Business Analyst simultaneously. As a member of the Analytics team, you'll gain hands-on experience building data solutions, developing reporting assets, and delivering insights that help drive business decisions.

You'll have meaningful ownership of projects while working alongside experienced team members who provide technical guidance, business context, coaching, and mentorship. Our goal is to help you grow through real-world challenges, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We're looking for a curious, technically minded problem solver who enjoys learning, thrives on new challenges, and wants to make an impact through data.

Location Requirements


Note: W.B. Mason will not provide relocation assistance for this position.
This role will operate in a hybrid working environment, meaning employees will work partly remote and partly in-office, with in-office time required at least once per week. The primary in-office location for this role is located at our Corporate Headquarters Office in Brockton, MA.


Exciting Benefits Of a W.B. Mason Career


$60,000 - $70,000 salary
Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Plans with $0 deductible (in-network) for all plans, with various plan designs to meet you and your family's needs
Company-paid Cell Phone Plan with unlimited text, talk and data; add a family member for only $55/month per line!
Superior Dental / Vision coverage, FSAs, free EAP, Company-paid life insurance, 401(k) and more!


What Makes Someone Successful In This Role


Technically Curious - You enjoy understanding how systems, data, and technology work. You're excited to learn new tools, explore unfamiliar concepts, and continuously expand your skills.
Driven Learner - You are self-motivated and committed to continuous improvement. You actively seek opportunities to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.
Critical Thinker & Problem Solver - You enjoy figuring things out. You look beyond surface-level answers, ask thoughtful questions, and work through complex problems to find practical solutions.
Impact Oriented - You are motivated by making a difference. You care about understanding the business problem, delivering value, and helping others make better decisions.
Detail Oriented - You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work while maintaining momentum. You understand the balance between attention to detail and perfectionism.
Collaborative - You work effectively with teammates and business partners, openly share ideas, welcome feedback, and contribute to a positive team environment.
Coachable - You are receptive to feedback, eager to learn from experienced team members, and view guidance as an opportunity to accelerate your growth.


Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Analytics Engineering

Help build and maintain the data foundation that powers reporting and analysis across the organization.


Partner with senior team members to develop scalable data solutions
Develop and maintain data assets within Microsoft Fabric
Write SQL, SparkSQL, and PySpark code to transform and prepare data for reporting and analysis
Improve data quality, automation, and analytical processes


Report Development

Create reporting solutions that help stakeholders understand and act on data.


Develop and maintain Microsoft Fabric semantic models, dashboards, and reports
Create reporting solutions that track key performance indicators and business outcomes
Design clear visualizations that communicate trends, opportunities, and challenges
Continuously improve reporting through automation, standardization, and user feedback


Analysis

Use data to answer business questions and support decision making.


Analyze business problems using data-driven approaches
Identify trends, opportunities, and root causes
Routinely prepare and communicate analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to business stakeholders and executive leadership through verbal presentations and written communication.
Help translate analytical insights into actionable business decisions
Collaborate with teammates and business partners to solve problems and deliver results
Perform other duties and projects as assigned


Education And/or Experience


Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline
1 year of analytical experience through internships, cooperative education programs, academic projects, extracurricular activities, or full-time employment
Foundational understanding of SQL and Python-based coding concepts used to acquire, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI or Tableau that transform data into clear, actionable insights for business users.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel to organize, transform, analyze, and visualize data in support of reporting and business decision making.


Preferred Qualifications


Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, SparkSQL, PySpark, or R through coursework, internships, projects, or professional experience
Experience developing semantic models and writing DAX calculations in Power BI
Experience using web analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics


Minimum Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, speak, and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is frequently required to use hands and fingers for data entry. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.
